youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用點手搖飲情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從排隊看菜單、選茶底、選純茶或加奶、糖度冰塊、加珍珠布丁、選杯子大小、取號外帶到搖勻分飲，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Ordering Bubble Tea phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). From queueing at the counter, choosing a tea base, milk or plain tea, sugar and ice levels, adding boba and pudding, picking a cup size, getting your number tag for takeout, to shaking and sharing with friends. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line outside this shop is really long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðɪs ʃɑp ɪz ˈrɪli lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這家店門口的隊伍真的排好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can join here and wait by the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn dʒɔɪn hɪr ænd weɪt baɪ ðə ˈkaʊntɚ./
dialogue.zh: 你可以從這裡排，在櫃台邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard this bubble tea place is famous.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ðɪs ˈbʌbəl ti pleɪs ɪz ˈfeɪməs./
dialogue.zh: 我聽說這家手搖飲店很有名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their roasted oolong sells out every weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈroʊstɪd ˈuˌlʊŋ sɛlz aʊt ˈɛvri ˈwiˌkɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 他們的炭焙烏龍每週末都會賣光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep is this line right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dip ɪz ðɪs laɪn raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這條隊現在排多深？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only four, so it moves pretty fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔr, soʊ ɪt muvz ˈprɪti fæst./
dialogue.zh: 只有四位，所以速度快得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a menu I can read now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈmɛnju aɪ kæn rid naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在有沒有菜單可以先看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big board above the counter lists everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ bɔrd əˈbʌv ðə ˈkaʊntɚ lɪsts ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 櫃台上方的大菜單板什麼都寫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many tea bases, it all looks new.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛni ti ˈbeɪsɪz, ɪt ɔl lʊks nu./
dialogue.zh: 茶底這麼多，每一樣我都沒喝過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, choosing is the fun part.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm, ˈtʃuzɪŋ ɪz ðə fʌn pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢挑，選茶底最好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tea tastes the lightest of all?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ti teɪsts ðə ˈlaɪstəst əv ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 哪種茶喝起來最清淡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green tea is the lightest one on the menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ti ɪz ðə ˈlaɪstəst wʌn ɑn ðə ˈmɛnju./
dialogue.zh: 綠茶是菜單上最輕盈的一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is special about jasmine green tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ˈspɛʃəl əˈbaʊt ˈdʒæzmɪn ɡrin ti?/
dialogue.zh: 茉莉綠茶特別在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has a gentle flower scent and taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz ə ˈdʒɛntəl ˈflaʊɚ sɛnt ænd teɪst./
dialogue.zh: 它有很溫柔的花香和甘味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is black tea much stronger than green?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz blæk ti mʌtʃ ˈstrɔŋɡɚ ðæn ɡrin?/
dialogue.zh: 紅茶比綠茶濃很多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, black tea has a deeper, stronger taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, blæk ti hæz ə ˈdipɚ, ˈstrɔŋɡɚ teɪst./
dialogue.zh: 對，紅茶的味道更深、更強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep white tea behind the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju kip waɪt ti bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkaʊntɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 你們櫃台後面有白茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We make white tea only when you ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪk waɪt ti ˈoʊnli wɛn ju æsk./
dialogue.zh: 白茶要特別說一聲，我們才現泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the premium row mean here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə ˈprimiəm roʊ min hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這邊寫的「特選」是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those teas cost a little more each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz tez kɔst ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr itʃ./
dialogue.zh: 那一排的茶，每杯會貴一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the pricier teas really better?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈpraɪsɪr tez ˈrɪli ˈbɛtɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 貴一點的茶真的比較好喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They taste smoother, that is why.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ teɪst ˈsmuðɚ, ðæt ɪz waɪ./
dialogue.zh: 喝起來比較滑順，所以才貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see fruit teas on the left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si frut tez ɑn ðə lɛft saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我看左邊有水果茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those have real fruit pieces inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz hæv ril frut ˈpisɪz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那些裡面裝的是真的水果塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the fresh fruits change with seasons?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə frɛʃ fruts tʃeɪndʒ wɪð ˈsizənz?/
dialogue.zh: 水果會依季節換種類嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Summer brings watermelon, winter brings warm lemon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmɚ brɪŋz ˈwɔtɚˌmɛlən, ˈwɪntɚ brɪŋz wɔrm ˈlɛmən./
dialogue.zh: 夏天有西瓜，冬天有熱檸檬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wintermelon tea looks like an old drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪntɚˌmɛlən ti lʊks laɪk æn oʊld drɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 冬瓜茶看起來是老字號飲品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a classic, sweet and very cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈklæsɪk, swit ænd ˈvɛri tʃip./
dialogue.zh: 它是經典款，甜甜又便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which base tea goes well with milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ beɪs ti ɡoʊz wɛl wɪð mɪlk?/
dialogue.zh: 哪種茶底最適合加奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Black tea is the safest choice with milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ti ɪz ðə ˈseɪfəst tʃɔɪs wɪð mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 紅茶加鮮奶最不會出錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can oolong work with milk too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ˈuˌlʊŋ wɜrk wɪð mɪlk tu?/
dialogue.zh: 烏龍茶也可以加奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, roasted oolong with milk smells great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ˈroʊstɪd ˈuˌlʊŋ wɪð mɪlk smɛlz ɡreɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以啊，炭焙烏龍加奶超香的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The picture shows cheese foam on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪktʃɚ ʃoʊz tʃiz foʊm ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 照片上那杯頂層是奶蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That salty cap sits on our oolong teas.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsɔlti kæp sɪts ɑn ɑʊr ˈuˌlʊŋ tez./
dialogue.zh: 那層鹹香奶蓋蓋在烏龍茶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheese foam sounds heavy, I am not sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃiz foʊm saʊndz ˈhɛvi, aɪ æm nɑt ʃʊr./
dialogue.zh: 奶蓋聽起來有點膩，我猶豫猶豫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can ask for just a thin layer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn æsk fɚ dʒʌst ə θɪn ˈleɪɚ./
dialogue.zh: 你可以請他們只鋪薄薄一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any tea without caffeine?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɛni ti wɪˈðaʊt ˈkæfəˌrin?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有不含咖啡因的茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our barley tea has no caffeine at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr ˈbɑrli ti hæz noʊ ˈkæfəˌrin æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我們的麥茶完全沒有咖啡因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Barley tea with boba? That is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑrli ti wɪð ˈboʊbə? ðæt ɪz nu tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 麥茶加珍珠？這我頭一回聽說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids order it a lot after school.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz ˈɔrdɚ ɪt ə lɑt ˈæftɚ skul./
dialogue.zh: 小朋友放學常常那樣點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat feels dry, what suits me now?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θroʊt filz draɪ, wʌt suts mi naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我喉嚨好乾，現在喝什麼剛好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the honey lemon green, it feels fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈhʌni ˈlɛmən ɡrin, ɪt filz frɛʃ./
dialogue.zh: 試試蜂蜜檸檬綠茶，很清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lemon drink very sour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈlɛmən drɪŋk ˈvɛri ˈsaʊɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 檸檬那款會不會很酸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The honey balances it, so it stays mild.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhʌni ˈbælənsɪz ɪt, soʊ ɪt steɪz maɪld./
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜會中和酸味，喝來柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot read this tiny writing on the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkænɑt rid ðɪs ˈtaɪni ˈraɪtɪŋ ɑn ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 菜單上的小字我看不清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me point at the popular ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi pɔɪnt æt ðə ˈpɑpjəlɚ wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 我來指給你看哪幾款最熱門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one do you sell the most?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn du ju sɛl ðə moʊst?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一款賣得最多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The classic milk tea with boba, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈklæsɪk mɪlk ti wɪð ˈboʊbə, ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 永遠是珍珠鮮奶茶，每天冠軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the board say you use fresh milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə bɔrd seɪ ju juz frɛʃ mɪlk?/
dialogue.zh: 菜單上寫你們用鮮奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, always fresh milk, not the powder.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɔlweɪz frɛʃ mɪlk, nɑt ðə ˈpaʊdɚ./
dialogue.zh: 對，一律鮮奶，不用奶精粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I stand while I decide?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ stænd waɪl aɪ dɪˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 我邊想邊站哪裡比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand close to the menu, take two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd kloʊs tu ðə ˈmɛnju, teɪk tu ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 站到菜單前面，先想個兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes is not enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts ɪz nɑt ɪˈnʌf fɚ mi./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘對我不夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then think of flavors you loved as a kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn θɪŋk əv ˈfleɪvɚz ju lʌvd æz ə kɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那就想想你小時候最愛的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I loved sweet potato drinks in winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌvd swit pəˈteɪtoʊ drɪŋks ɪn ˈwɪntɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我小時候冬天最愛地瓜飲品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a warm taro milk close to that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ə wɔrm ˈtɑroʊ mɪlk kloʊs tu ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我們有杯熱芋頭奶，感覺很接近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taro sounds good, but today I want tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɑroʊ saʊndz ɡʊd, bʌt təˈdeɪ aɪ wɑnt ti./
dialogue.zh: 芋頭也不錯，但我今天想喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pick a base first, milk comes later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɪk ə beɪs fɜrst, mɪlk kʌmz ˈleɪtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 那就先選茶底，奶等等再決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green, black, oolong, which do you love?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin, blæk, ˈuˌlʊŋ, wɪtʃ du ju lʌv./
dialogue.zh: 綠茶、紅茶、烏龍，你偏愛哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For me, oolong, because it smells like nuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ mi, ˈuˌlʊŋ, bɪˈkʌz ɪt smɛlz laɪk nʌts./
dialogue.zh: 我選烏龍，因為喝起來有堅果香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nuts in tea? Now I am curious.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌts ɪn ti? naʊ aɪ æm ˈkjʊriəs./
dialogue.zh: 茶裡有堅果香？我被勾起好奇心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try a small cup first, then decide for real.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ə smɔl kʌp fɜrst, ðɛn dɪˈsaɪd fɚ ril./
dialogue.zh: 先試小杯，再認真決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The board also shows sugar and ice levels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɔrd ˈɔlsoʊ ʃoʊz ˈʃʊɡɚ ænd aɪs ˈlɛvəlz./
dialogue.zh: 看板上還有糖度和冰塊的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We fix those after you choose a base.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi fɪks ðoz ˈæftɚ ju tʃuz ə beɪs./
dialogue.zh: 選好茶底，我們再來調那些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And toppings come last, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈtɑpɪŋz kʌm læst, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 加料排在最後，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, pearls and puddings wait at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt, pɜrlz ænd ˈpʊdɪŋz weɪt æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，珍珠和布丁最後再加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The queue moved, I am almost at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kju muvd, aɪ æm ˈɔlmoʊst æt ðə ˈkaʊntɚ./
dialogue.zh: 隊伍往前了，我快站到櫃台前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, tell me your tea choice now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, tɛl mi jʊr ti tʃɔɪs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，現在告訴我你的茶底選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will start with the jasmine green tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stɑrt wɪð ðə ˈdʒæzmɪn ɡrin ti./
dialogue.zh: 我先從茉莉綠茶開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, that one goes with anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs, ðæt wʌn ɡoʊz wɪð ˈɛniˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 選得好，那款配什麼都不怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, can I save oolong for next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, kæn aɪ seɪv ˈuˌlʊŋ fɔr nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我可以把烏龍留到下次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, next time try it with milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs, nɛkst taɪm traɪ ɪt wɪð mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，下次來杯烏龍加奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the jasmine tea come hot or cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈdʒæzmɪn ti kʌm hɑt ɔr koʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 茉莉茶可以做熱的還是冰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both work, most people take it iced.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ wɜrk, moʊst ˈpipəl teɪk ɪt aɪst./
dialogue.zh: 兩種都行，多數人選加冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Iced fits this hot afternoon perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪst fɪts ðɪs hɑt ˌæftɚˈnun ˈpɜrfɪktli./
dialogue.zh: 這麼熱的下午，就該喝冰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, but first decide: tea only or with milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, bʌt fɜrst dɪˈsaɪd: ti ˈoʊnli ɔr wɪð mɪlk?/
dialogue.zh: 好，但先決定：純茶還是加奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the next question already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə nɛkst ˈkwɛstʃən ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 這就要問下一個問題了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every cup gets built step by step.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɛvri kʌp ɡɛts ˈbɪlt stɛp baɪ stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 對，每一杯都是一步一步組出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me one more second with the menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi wʌn mɔr ˈsɛkənd wɪð ðə ˈmɛnju./
dialogue.zh: 再讓我多看一會兒菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the bases are all in two rows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ði ˈbeɪsɪz ɑr ɔl ɪn tu roʊz./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，茶底都列在那兩排上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two rows, cheap classics and premium blends.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu roʊz, tʃip ˈklæsɪks ænd ˈprimiəm blɛndz./
dialogue.zh: 兩排：平價經典款和特調精選款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The upper row takes slower, careful roasting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʌpɚ roʊ teɪks ˈsloʊwɚ, ˈkɛrfəl ˈroʊstɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 上面那排的葉子焙得更慢更用心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slower roasting makes such a difference?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊwɚ ˈroʊstɪŋ meɪks sʌtʃ ə ˈdɪfərəns?/
dialogue.zh: 焙得慢，差別有那麼大？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes away the rough bitter edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪks əˈweɪ ðə rʌf ˈbɪtɚ ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 它會磨掉粗糙的苦味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I at the front of the line now?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ æt ðə frʌnt əv ðə laɪn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在排到最前面了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one customer before you is ordering.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst, wʌn ˈkʌstəmɚ bɪˈfɔr ju ɪz ˈɔrdərɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，你前面那位正在點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will speak to the counter now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, aɪ wɪl spik tu ðə ˈkaʊntɚ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我現在可以跟櫃台說了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am right here, what tea for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm raɪt hɪr, wʌt ti fɚ ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我就在這裡，你要哪種茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The jasmine green, still deciding on milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdʒæzmɪn ɡrin, stɪl dɪˈsaɪdɪŋ ɑn mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 茉莉綠茶，加不加奶還在想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us clear that milk question first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs klɪr ðæt mɪlk ˈkwɛstʃən fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 那我們先把加奶這件事講清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is plain tea better for a beginner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz pleɪn ti ˈbɛtɚ fɚ ə bɪˈɡɪnɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 純茶對新手是不是比較友好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain tea shows the true taste of the leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ti ʃoʊz ðə tru teɪst əv ðə lif./
dialogue.zh: 純茶會呈現茶葉真正的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And milk makes everything softer and sweeter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd mɪlk meɪks ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈsɔftɚ ænd ˈswitɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 那加奶會讓茶變柔變甜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, milk rounds the hard edge of tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, mɪlk raʊndz ðə hɑrd ɛdʒ əv ti./
dialogue.zh: 對，奶會把茶的刺感磨圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I came this far, let us decide fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ keɪm ðɪs fɑr, lɛt ʌs dɪˈsaɪd fæst./
dialogue.zh: 我都排到這裡了，快點決定吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me one word: milk or none.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi wʌn wɜrd: mɪlk ɔr nʌn./
dialogue.zh: 給我一個答案：加奶，或不加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, I still cannot decide that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli, aɪ stɪl ˈkænɑt dɪˈsaɪd ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這個我還真選不下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, next we compare plain and milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ, nɛkst wi kəmˈpɛr pleɪn ænd mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 不急，接下來我們比較純茶跟奶茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, I want to hear the options.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du, aɪ wɑnt tu hɪr ði ˈɑpʃənz./
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我想聽聽有哪些選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, let me paint the plain tea picture.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, lɛt mi peɪnt ðə pleɪn ti ˈpɪktʃɚ./
dialogue.zh: 先讓我描述純茶是什麼樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plain tea means nothing added, just tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ti minz ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈædɪd, dʒʌst ti./
dialogue.zh: 純茶就是什麼都不加，只有茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it comes straight from the leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt kʌmz streɪt frʌm ðə lif./
dialogue.zh: 喝的是茶葉本身的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So plain tea is the honest choice?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ pleɪn ti ɪz ðə ˈɑnɪst tʃɔɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 所以純茶是最誠實的選法？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you taste exactly what the leaf gives.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ju teɪst ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ðə lif ɡɪvz./
dialogue.zh: 對，茶葉什麼味道，你就喝什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what changes when milk goes in?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz wɛn mɪlk ɡoʊz ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那加奶之後，會改變什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk makes it creamy and easy to drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk meɪks ɪt ˈkrimi ænd ˈizi tu drɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 奶會讓它變奶香、變順口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does milk hide the bitter taste?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz mɪlk haɪd ðə ˈbɪtɚ teɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 奶會蓋掉苦味嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, bitterness softens under fresh milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, ˈbɪtɚnəs ˈsɔfənd ˈʌndɚ frɛʃ mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，苦味會被鮮奶壓下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tried milk tea once at a mall.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ traɪd mɪlk ti wʌns æt ə mɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我曾在百貨公司喝過一次奶茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And how did that first cup feel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd haʊ dɪd ðæt fɜrst kʌp fil?/
dialogue.zh: 那第一杯喝起來感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too sweet, like a dessert in a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu swit, laɪk ə dɪˈzɜrt ɪn ə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 太甜了，像杯裡的甜點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was probably the sugar, not the milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ˈprɑbəbli ðə ˈʃʊɡɚ, nɑt ðə mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 那大概是糖的問題，不是奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So milk itself is not the sweet thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ mɪlk ɪtˈsɛlf ɪz nɑt ðə swit θɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 所以奶本身並不甜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, milk adds roundness, not candy sweetness.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, mɪlk ˈædz ˈraʊndnəs, nɑt ˈkændi ˈswitnəs./
dialogue.zh: 對，奶帶來的是圓潤，不是糖果甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What kinds of milk can I choose?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt kaɪndz əv mɪlk kæn aɪ tʃuz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以選哪幾種奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh dairy, oat milk, or no milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ ˈdɛri, oʊt mɪlk, ɔr noʊ mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 鮮奶、燕麥奶，或不加奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oat milk? That is a new one here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊt mɪlk? ðæt ɪz ə nu wʌn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 燕麥奶？這選擇對我蠻新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is popular, it tastes nutty and light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈpɑpjəlɚ, ɪt teɪsts ˈnʌti ænd laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它很熱門，喝起來有堅果香又不膩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does oat milk change the tea flavor?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz oʊt mɪlk tʃeɪndʒ ðə ti ˈfleɪvɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 燕麥奶會改變茶的味道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slightly, it covers green tea more than black.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslaɪtli, ɪt ˈkʌvɚz ɡrin ti mɔr ðæn blæk./
dialogue.zh: 會一點，蓋綠茶比蓋紅茶蓋得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then maybe dairy for my jasmine green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈmeɪbi ˈdɛri fɚ maɪ ˈdʒæzmɪn ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 那我的茉莉綠茶還是用鮮奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, a splash keeps the flower scent alive.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, ə splæʃ kips ðə ˈflaʊɚ sɛnt əˈlaɪv./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，只淋一點，花香還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How small is one splash, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ smɔl ɪz wʌn splæʃ, ɪɡˈzæktli./
dialogue.zh: 一點點到底是多小？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three sips of milk in one cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri sɪps əv mɪlk ɪn wʌn kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 大概一杯裡加三口的量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a full milk tea, how much milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə fʊl mɪlk ti, haʊ mʌtʃ mɪlk?/
dialogue.zh: 那完整的奶茶要多少奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One third of the cup is milk there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɜrd əv ðə kʌp ɪz mɪlk ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那種杯裡三分之一都是奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Between splash and full, is there a middle?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈtwin splæʃ ænd fʊl, ɪz ðɛr ə ˈmɪdəl?/
dialogue.zh: 從一點到很多之間，還有中間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, half and half is a common call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, hæf ænd hæf ɪz ə ˈkɑmən kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 當然，一半一半也很常有人點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People really have opinions about milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl ˈrɪli hæv əˈpɪnjənz əˈbaʊt mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 大家對加奶果然各有各的想法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every regular has their own milk setting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈrɛɡjəlɚ hæz ðɛr oʊn mɪlk ˈsɛtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 每個常客都有自己的固定加奶量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do the regulars here mostly pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ðə ˈrɛɡjəlɚz hɪr ˈmoʊstli pɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的老顧客大多怎麼選？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For green tea, most skip the milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ɡrin ti, moʊst skɪp ðə mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 點綠茶的人，大部分不加奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For black tea, does that flip around?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ blæk ti, dʌz ðæt flɪp əˈraʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 換成紅茶，情況會反過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, black tea with milk is the house habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, blæk ti wɪð mɪlk ɪz ðə haʊs ˈhæbɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，紅茶加奶是店裡的預設習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So lighter teas need a smaller splash?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈlaɪtɚ tez nid ə ˈsmɔlər splæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 所以茶越清淡，奶就要淋越少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a good rule, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd rul, ˈɑnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這條規矩挺可靠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about fruit teas, milk with those?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt frut tez, mɪlk wɪð ðoz?/
dialogue.zh: 那水果茶呢，可以加奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, milk and fruit tea fight badly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ, mɪlk ænd frut ti faɪt ˈbædli./
dialogue.zh: 千萬別，奶配水果茶會出狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fight badly? Now that made me laugh.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪt ˈbædli? naʊ ðæt meɪd mi læf./
dialogue.zh: 出狀況？這說法讓我笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turns chunky, the taste goes strange fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɜrnz ˈtʃʌki, ðə teɪst ɡoʊz streɪndʒ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 奶會結成小塊，味道馬上變怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, my jasmine stays clean then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu noʊ, maɪ ˈdʒæzmɪn steɪz klin ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好在問了，我的茉莉茶味道乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked about milk for a reason, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju æskt əˈbaʊt mɪlk fɔr ə ˈrizən, jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 你會問到奶，一定有原因吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, creamy drinks make me happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈkrimi drɪŋks meɪk mi ˈhæpi./
dialogue.zh: 對，帶奶香的就讓我開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a splash in your green keeps both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə splæʃ ɪn jʊr ɡrin kips boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 那你的綠茶淋一點，兩邊都保住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both meaning tea taste and creamy feel?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈminɪŋ ti teɪst ænd ˈkrimi fil?/
dialogue.zh: 兩邊是指茶味和奶香都要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, a small splash is the sweet spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ə smɔl splæʃ ɪz ðə swit spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，加一點點剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write that down, a light splash of milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðæt daʊn, ə laɪt splæʃ əv mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 記下來：鮮奶輕輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, jasmine green with a light splash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, ˈdʒæzmɪn ɡrin wɪð ə laɪt splæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，茉莉綠茶加一點點奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you measure one splash there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju ˈmɛʒɚ wʌn splæʃ ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們怎麼量那一點點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use a small jug, just two seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi juz ə smɔl dʒʌɡ, dʒʌst tu ˈsɛkəndz./
dialogue.zh: 我們用量杯，只倒兩秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seconds of pouring, that is precise.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsɛkəndz əv ˈpɔrɪŋ, ðæt ɪz prɪˈsaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 倒數兩秒，好精準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We practice that every single morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈpræktɪs ðæt ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們每天早上都練這個動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small details matter more in a busy shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl dɪˈteɪlz ˈmætɚ mɔr ɪn ə ˈbɪzi ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 越忙的店，小細節越要講究。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, a wrong splash spoils a whole cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, ə rɔŋ splæʃ spɔɪlz ə hoʊl kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 真的，奶加錯就毀了一整杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then today, careful splash, no mistakes please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn təˈdeɪ, ˈkɛrfəl splæʃ, noʊ mɪˈsteɪks pliz./
dialogue.zh: 那今天請小心那一淋，別失手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will get exactly one careful splash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl ɡɛt ɪɡˈzæktli wʌn ˈkɛrfəl splæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 你會得到剛剛好的那一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I smell the oat milk first?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ smɛl ði oʊt mɪlk fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以先聞一下燕麥奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here, it smells like warm grain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs, hɪr, ɪt smɛlz laɪk wɔrm ɡreɪn./
dialogue.zh: 當然，來，它聞起來像穀香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, but my tea today wants dairy.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, bʌt maɪ ti təˈdeɪ wɑnts ˈdɛri./
dialogue.zh: 不錯，但我今天的茶屬意鮮奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dairy it is, fresh from the fridge now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɛri ɪt ɪz, frɛʃ frʌm ðə frɪdʒ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那就鮮奶，現在從冰箱取新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that fridge milk cold when you pour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt frɪdʒ mɪlk koʊld wɛn ju pɔr./
dialogue.zh: 冰箱那罐奶，倒出來是冰的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stays cold, so your ice survives.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt steɪz koʊld, soʊ jʊr aɪs sɚˈvaɪvz./
dialogue.zh: 對，奶是冰的，冰塊化得慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice melts so fast on a day like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs mɛlts soʊ fæst ɑn ə deɪ laɪk ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 這種天氣，冰化得飛快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With cold milk, you gain ten good minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð koʊld mɪlk, ju ɡeɪn tɛn ɡʊd ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 冰涼的奶一加，冰能多撐十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a milk cap make my drink sweeter?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ə mɪlk kæp meɪk maɪ drɪŋk ˈswitɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 加奶蓋會讓我的飲變甜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cap foam leans salty, so watch your sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæp foʊm linz ˈsɔlti, soʊ wɑtʃ jʊr ˈʃʊɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 奶蓋偏鹹，糖度就要留神。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salty with sweet tea? That combination works?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔlti wɪð swit ti? ðæt kəmˌbineɪʃən wɜrks?/
dialogue.zh: 鹹的配甜茶？這種組合行得通？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works, the salt lifts the tea flavor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrks, ðə sɔlt lɪfts ðə ti ˈfleɪvɚ./
dialogue.zh: 行得通，鹹味會把茶味抬起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now you made salty foam sound fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ju meɪd ˈsɔlti foʊm saʊnd fʌn./
dialogue.zh: 你讓我覺得鹹奶蓋很有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time then, today we keep it simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm ðɛn, təˈdeɪ wi kip ɪt ˈsɪmpəl./
dialogue.zh: 那個留給下次，今天先簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple and correct beats fancy and wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl ænd kəˈrɛkt bits ˈfænsi ænd rɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 選對的簡單，勝過出錯的華麗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every busy worker quietly agrees with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈbɪzi ˈwɜrkɚ ˈkwaɪətli əˈɡriz wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 每個忙碌的店員都會偷偷點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one more milk question from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, wʌn mɔr mɪlk ˈkwɛstʃən frʌm mi./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我還有最後一個奶的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask away, we still have two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk əˈweɪ, wi stɪl hæv tu ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 你問吧，我們還有兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you warm milk when tea is hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɔrm mɪlk wɛn ti ɪz hɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 熱茶的話，奶也會溫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hot tea gets gently warmed milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɑt ti ɡɛts ˈdʒɛntli wɔrmd mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 對，熱茶會配微微加熱的奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And cold drinks get the cold milk only?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd koʊld drɪŋks ɡɛt ðə koʊld mɪlk ˈoʊnli?/
dialogue.zh: 冰飲就一律用冰的奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, matching temperatures keeps the taste clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ˈmætʃɪŋ ˈtɛmprətʃɚz kips ðə teɪst klin./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，溫度一致，味道才乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My jasmine is iced, so cold milk please.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdʒæzmɪn ɪz aɪst, soʊ koʊld mɪlk pliz./
dialogue.zh: 我的茉莉綠是冰的，請用冰奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold splash, coming right into your cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld splæʃ, ˈkʌmɪŋ raɪt ˈɪntu jʊr kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 冰奶輕輕一淋，馬上進你的杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This ordering feels like building something.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈɔrdərɪŋ filz laɪk ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 點這杯好像在組裝什麼東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, one careful layer after another.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz, wʌn ˈkɛrfəl ˈleɪɚ ˈæftɚ əˈnʌðɚ./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，一層一層小心疊上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So milk sits between tea and toppings?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ mɪlk sɪts bɪˈtwin ti ænd ˈtɑpɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 所以奶是介於茶和料之間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It mixes with tea, toppings sink below.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈmɪksɪz wɪð ti, ˈtɑpɪŋz sɪŋk bɪˈloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 奶跟茶混勻，料沉在杯底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toppings sinking means the last sip is rich.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɑpɪŋz ˈsɪŋkɪŋ minz ðə læst sɪp ɪz rɪtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 料沉底，代表最後一口最濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why people shake their cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ ˈpipəl ʃeɪk ðɛr kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 所以大家喝前都要搖一搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake? I will remember that for later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk? aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt fɚ ˈleɪtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 搖？這點我記住了，等等用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, shake well before your first real sip.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃeɪk wɛl bɪˈfɔr jʊr fɜrst ril sɪp./
dialogue.zh: 對，第一口之前先搖勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, milk plan done, I feel lighter.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, mɪlk plæn dʌn, aɪ fil ˈlaɪtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 好，奶的部分決定了，我輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next is sugar, people speak in numbers there.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ɪz ˈʃʊɡɚ, ˈpipəl spik ɪn ˈnʌmbɚz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 接著是糖度，那邊用數字說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbers? Do not scare me with math.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚz? du nɑt skɛr mi wɪð mæθ./
dialogue.zh: 數字？別用數學嚇我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy ones, thirty percent or fifty percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi wʌnz, ˈθɜrti pɚˈsɛnt ɔr ˈfɪfti pɚˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 很簡單的，三成或五成那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Percentages of sweetness, got it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɚˈsɛntɪdʒɪz əv ˈswitnəs, ɡɑt ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 原來是甜度的百分比，我懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, lower percent, fewer sugar grams.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ˈloʊɚ pɚˈsɛnt, ˈfjʊɚ ˈʃʊɡɚ ɡræmz./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，數字越低，糖的克數越少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I get the zero sugar people.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ ɡɛt ðə ˈzɪroʊ ˈʃʊɡɚ ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 我現在懂那些要無糖的人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone starts somewhere, today you started here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn stɑrts ˈsʌmwɛr, təˈdeɪ ju stɑrtɪd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 每個人都有第一次，你的是今天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like how this is going, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk haʊ ðɪs ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ, ˈɑnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我很喜歡現在的進度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely halfway through your perfect cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛrli ˈhæfˈweɪ θru jʊr ˈpɜrfɪkt kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 你這杯的完美路線才走一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us finish the sugar part now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈʃʊɡɚ pɑrt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在把糖度搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow me, the sugar chart is right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ mi, ðə ˈʃʊɡɚ tʃɑrt ɪz raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 過來，糖度對照表就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chart shows five sugar choices.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɑrt ʃoʊz faɪv ˈʃʊɡɚ ˈtʃɔɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 這張表上有五種糖度可選。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero, thirty, fifty, seventy, and one hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈzɪroʊ, ˈθɜrti, ˈfɪfti, ˈsɛvənti, ænd wʌn ˈhʌndrəd./
dialogue.zh: 無糖、三成、五成、七成、全糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Percent means how sweet the cup is.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɚˈsɛnt minz haʊ swit ðə kʌp ɪz./
dialogue.zh: 百分比就是這杯有多甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, one hundred is the fullest sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ɪz ðə ˈfʊləst ˈʃʊɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 對，全糖就是甜到最滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the thirty percent taste like?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə ˈθɜrti pɚˈsɛnt teɪst laɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 三成喝起來是什麼感覺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft hint, you still taste the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔft hɪnt, ju stɪl teɪst ðə ti./
dialogue.zh: 淡淡一點甜，茶味還是主角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is fifty the middle of the chart?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈfɪfti ðə ˈmɪdəl əv ðə tʃɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 五成是這張表的中間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, most first orders choose fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, moʊst fɜrst ˈɔrdɚz tʃuz ˈfɪfti./
dialogue.zh: 對，第一次來的人大多選五成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is my number, right in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ, raɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl./
dialogue.zh: 就這個數字，穩穩在中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good start, taste one sip and tell me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd stɑrt, teɪst wʌn sɪp ænd tɛl mi./
dialogue.zh: 好的開始，喝一口再告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adjust? Can I change sugar after paying?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈdʒʌst? kæn aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ˈʃʊɡɚ ˈæftɚ ˈpeɪɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 調整？付完錢還能改糖度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back before shaking and we fix it free.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk bɪˈfɔr ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ænd wi fɪks ɪt fri./
dialogue.zh: 搖之前回來找我們，免費幫你改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free fix? That is generous of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri fɪks? ðæt ɪz ˈdʒɛnɚəs əv ju./
dialogue.zh: 免費改？你們也太寬厚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hate wasting a perfectly good cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi heɪt ˈweɪstɪŋ ə ˈpɜrfɪktli ɡʊd kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我們捨不得一杯好茶被倒掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, so what syrup do you use?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, soʊ wʌt ˈsɪrəp du ju juz./
dialogue.zh: 好，那你們用的是哪種糖水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two kinds: house sugar syrup or brown sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kaɪndz: haʊs ˈʃʊɡɚ ˈsɪrəp ɔr braʊn ˈʃʊɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 兩種：店家糖水或黑糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brown sugar sounds deeper and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn ˈʃʊɡɚ saʊndz ˈdipɚ ænd wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 黑糖聽起來層次更深、更暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It brings a caramel note to any tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt brɪŋz ə ˈkɑrəˌmɛl noʊt tu ˈɛni ti./
dialogue.zh: 它會幫任何茶添一層焦糖香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Caramel in tea? Like a dessert, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑrəˌmɛl ɪn ti? laɪk ə dɪˈzɜrt, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 茶裡的焦糖？像甜點一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gentler, just a hint of toasted sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntlɚ, dʒʌst ə hɪnt əv ˈtoʊstɪd ˈʃʊɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 沒那麼誇張，只是微微焙糖香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does brown sugar fit jasmine green tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz braʊn ˈʃʊɡɚ fɪt ˈdʒæzmɪn ɡrin ti?/
dialogue.zh: 黑糖適合配茉莉綠茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For green, clear syrup protects the flower note.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ɡrin, klɪr ˈsɪrəp prəˈtɛkts ðə ˈflaʊɚ noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 喝綠茶的話，透明糖水護住花香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clear syrup is the invisible sugar?
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪr ˈsɪrəp ɪz ðə ɪnˈvɪzəbəl ˈʃʊɡɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 透明糖水就是看不見的糖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it sweetens without adding its own flavor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ˈswitənz wɪˈðaʊt ˈædɪŋ ɪts oʊn ˈfleɪvɚ./
dialogue.zh: 對，它只帶甜，不搶味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about honey, do you have that?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈhʌni, du ju hæv ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 那蜂蜜呢，你們有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We offer wild honey as a swap option.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔfɚ waɪld ˈhʌni æz ə swɑp ˈɑpʃən./
dialogue.zh: 我們提供野生蜂蜜當作換糖選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switching to honey costs extra, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswɪtʃɪŋ tu ˈhʌni kɔsts ˈɛkstrə, raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 換成蜂蜜要加錢，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just fifty cents, honey is pricier than syrup.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈfɪfti sɛnts, ˈhʌni ɪz ˈpraɪsɪr ðæn ˈsɪrəp./
dialogue.zh: 只多五十美分，蜂蜜比較貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty cents, not bad for real honey.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti sɛnts, nɑt bæd fɚ ril ˈhʌni./
dialogue.zh: 五十美分，真蜂蜜算便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some guests say it is worth twice that.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ɡɛsts seɪ ɪt ɪz wɜrθ twaɪs ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 有客人說兩倍的價也值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today I stay with the house syrup.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ aɪ steɪ wɪð ðə haʊs ˈsɪrəp./
dialogue.zh: 今天我就用店裡的糖水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic pick, it never argues with tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk pɪk, ɪt ˈnɛvɚ əɡˈraʊz wɪð ti./
dialogue.zh: 經典選擇，它從不跟茶吵架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar-free sounds strict, does zero exist?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ fri saʊndz strɪkt, dʌz ˈzɪroʊ ɪɡˈzɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 無糖聽起來很嚴格，真的存在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero means zero drops, truly no sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈzɪroʊ minz ˈzɪroʊ drɑps, ˈtruli noʊ ˈʃʊɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 無糖就是一滴都不加，真的零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who orders zero percent around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ˈɔrdɚz ˈzɪroʊ pɚˈsɛnt əˈraʊnd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡誰會點無糖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Runners and aunties who know the leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌnɚz ænd ˈæntiz hu noʊ ðə livz./
dialogue.zh: 跑步的人，和懂茶的大姊們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you push zero on a beginner?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju pʊʃ ˈzɪroʊ ɑn ə bɪˈɡɪnɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 你會勸新手直接無糖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, start at fifty and walk down slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, stɑrt æt ˈfɪfti ænd wɔk daʊn ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 不會，先從五成開始慢慢降。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk down means less sugar each time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk daʊn minz lɛs ˈʃʊɡɚ itʃ taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢降就是每次少一點糖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, your tongue adjusts within three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, jʊr tʌŋ əˈdʒʌsts wɪˈθɪn θri wikz./
dialogue.zh: 對，三週內舌頭就會習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three weeks, I can try that plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri wikz, aɪ kæn traɪ ðæt plæn./
dialogue.zh: 三週而已，我可以試試這個計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start today, fifty with a jasmine base.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt təˈdeɪ, ˈfɪfti wɪð ə ˈdʒæzmɪn beɪs./
dialogue.zh: 今天就開始，茉莉茶底配五成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, actually seventy might suit me more.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, ˈæktʃuəli ˈsɛvənti maɪt sut mi mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，其實七成可能更合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seventy tastes sweet without the sticky edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvənti teɪsts swit wɪˈðaʊt ðə ˈstɪki ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 七成是甜，但不會黏膩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sticky sweet, that is not my world.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪki swit, ðæt ɪz nɑt maɪ wɜrld./
dialogue.zh: 黏呼呼的甜，不是我的世界。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stay fifty, trust the middle road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn steɪ ˈfɪfti, trʌst ðə ˈmɪdəl roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那就留在五成，相信中間路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty it is, write it on the label.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ɪt ɪz, raɪt ɪt ɑn ðə ˈleɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 就五成，寫在標籤上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We mark sugar on every cup lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mɑrk ˈʃʊɡɚ ɑn ˈɛvri kʌp lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我們會在杯蓋上標糖度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lid shows my whole personality then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪd ʃoʊz maɪ hoʊl ˌpɜrsəˈnæləti ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那杯蓋等於寫出我的個性了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine says forty, I broke the chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sɛz ˈfɔrti, aɪ broʊk ðə tʃɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 我都是四十，我跳出了表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty exists? Your scale has secrets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ɪɡˈzɪsts? jʊr skeɪl hæz ˈsikrɪts./
dialogue.zh: 有四成？你們的刻度有祕密。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Staff specials, we taste outside the menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæf ˈspɛʃəlz, wi teɪst ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈmɛnju./
dialogue.zh: 員工私房比例，菜單外也有滋味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not tell the other customers that.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tɛl ði ˈʌðɚ ˈkʌstəmərz ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 別跟其他客人說這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our secret lives inside this cup today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr ˈsikrɪt lɪvz ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs kʌp təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這個祕密今天只藏在你這杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar settled, what is the next choice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ ˈsɛtəld, wʌt ɪz ðə nɛkst tʃɔɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 糖決定了，下一個選項是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next is ice, how much do you want?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ɪz aɪs, haʊ mʌtʃ du ju wɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 接下來是冰塊，你要多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice too? Another choice to make.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs tu? əˈnʌðɚ tʃɔɪs tə meɪk./
dialogue.zh: 冰也要選？又一道選擇題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but easy ones: normal, less, or none.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt ˈizi wʌnz: ˈnɔrməl, lɛs, ɔr nʌn./
dialogue.zh: 對，但很簡單：正常、少冰、或去冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So ice can water the sweetness down.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪs kæn ˈwɔtɚ ðə ˈswitnəs daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 所以冰會把甜度沖淡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, as ice melts, sweetness spreads thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, æz aɪs mɛlts, ˈswitnəs sprɛdz θɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，冰一化，甜就攤薄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything about sugar I should ask first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈʃʊɡɚ aɪ ʃʊd æsk fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 關於糖，還有什麼是我該先問的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tapioca pearls arrive soaked in sweet syrup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌtæpiˈoʊkə pɜrlz əˈraɪv soʊkt ɪn swit ˈsɪrəp./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠本身是泡在糖漿裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pearls carry sugar? I had no idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrlz ˈkæri ˈʃʊɡɚ? aɪ hæd noʊ aɪˈdiə./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠也帶糖？我完全不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So pearls plus fifty tastes like seventy.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ pɜrlz plʌs ˈfɪfti teɪsts laɪk ˈsɛvənti./
dialogue.zh: 所以加珍珠的五成，喝來像七成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then maybe forty is smarter with pearls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈmeɪbi ˈfɔrti ɪz ˈsmɑrtɚ wɪð pɜrlz./
dialogue.zh: 那要加珍珠的話，四成更聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move, you learn fast at this.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muv, ju lɜrn fæst æt ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，你上手真的很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call it forty, final answer on sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ɪt ˈfɔrti, ˈfaɪnəl ˈænsɚ ɑn ˈʃʊɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 就四成，糖度最後答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty with pearls, noted on your lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti wɪð pɜrlz, ˈnoʊtɪd ɑn jʊr lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 四成配珍珠，杯蓋記錄完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I just make this shop proud?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ dʒʌst meɪk ðɪs ʃɑp praʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛讓這家店以我為榮了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You ordered like your fifth cup already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɔrdɚd laɪk jʊr faɪθ kʌp ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 你點起來像已經喝到第五杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only my first, but I paid close attention.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli maɪ fɜrst, bʌt aɪ peɪd kloʊs əˈtɛnʃən./
dialogue.zh: 雖然這是第一杯，但我很專心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full marks, the tea world welcomes you.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl mɑrks, ðə ti wɜrld wɛlkəmz ju./
dialogue.zh: 滿分，茶的世界歡迎你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is fruit tea sweet even at zero?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz frut ti swit ˈivɪn æt ˈzɪroʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 水果茶就算無糖也是甜的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fruit carries its own natural sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, frut ˈkæriz ɪts oʊn ˈnætʃɚəl ˈʃʊɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 對，水果本身就有天然的甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So zero there means fruit sweetness only?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈzɪroʊ ðɛr minz frut ˈswitnəs ˈoʊnli?/
dialogue.zh: 所以那邊的無糖只是水果甜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, no syrup, just the fruit itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt, noʊ ˈsɪrəp, dʒʌst ðə frut ɪtˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，不加糖水，只有果甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, my friend wants one too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ, maɪ frɛnd wɑnts wʌn tu./
dialogue.zh: 好在問了，我朋友也想喝一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can build her own cup next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn bɪld hɜr oʊn kʌp nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 下一杯就換她自己配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids here, do they choose low sugar?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz hɪr, du ðeɪ tʃuz loʊ ˈʃʊɡɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的小朋友會選低糖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most kids demand the full hundred percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst kɪdz dɪˈmænd ðə fʊl ˈhʌndrəd pɚˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 大部分小孩都要全糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hundred in a small stomach, oh my.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhʌndrəd ɪn ə smɔl ˈstʌmək, oʊ maɪ./
dialogue.zh: 小肚子灌全糖，我的天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Parents often cut it down to seventy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛrənts ˈɔfən kʌt ɪt daʊn tu ˈsɛvənti./
dialogue.zh: 爸媽通常會幫他們降到七成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Late at night, sugar feels sweeter, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt æt naɪt, ˈʃʊɡɚ filz ˈswitɚ, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 深夜的時候，糖會感覺更甜，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sugar tastes louder after dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈʃʊɡɚ teɪsts ˈlaʊdɚ ˈæftɚ dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 對，天黑以後，甜會更響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing I came in early today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ aɪ keɪm ɪn ˈɜrli təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 還好我今天早一點來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So your forty stays a true forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ jʊr ˈfɔrti steɪz ə tru ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 所以你這杯四成，就是實實在在的四成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar is personal, like a fingerprint.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ ɪz ˈpɜrsənəl, laɪk ə ˈfɪŋɡɚˌprɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 糖度很私人，像指紋一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The nicest fingerprint on a cup lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnaɪsɪst ˈfɪŋɡɚˌprɪnt ɑn ə kʌp lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 蓋子上最美的指紋就是它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I laughed twice today, this counter is fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ læft twaɪs təˈdeɪ, ðɪs ˈkaʊntɚ ɪz fʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我今天笑了兩次，這個櫃台真有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fun is part of the job description.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʌn ɪz pɑrt əv ðə dʒɑb ˌdɛskrɪpˈʃən./
dialogue.zh: 讓人開心本來就是工作內容之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, will you remember me?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm, wɪl ju rɪˈmɛmbɚ mi?/
dialogue.zh: 下次你還會記得我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty with pearls, I will never forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti wɪð pɜrlz, aɪ wɪl ˈnɛvɚ fɚˈɡɛt./
dialogue.zh: 四成加珍珠，我絕對忘不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the sweetest thing I heard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈswitɪst θɪŋ aɪ hɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 這是我今天聽過最甜的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, sweeter words belong to your tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ˈswitɚ wɜrdz bɪˈlɔŋ tu jʊr ti./
dialogue.zh: 別誇了，比你會說甜話的是你那杯茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tea, my forty, my small victory.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ti, maɪ ˈfɔrti, maɪ smɔl ˈvɪktəri./
dialogue.zh: 我的茶、我的四成、我小小的勝利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Victories deserve ice next, how much?
dialogue.phonetic: /vɪkˈtɔriz dɪˈzɜrv aɪs nɛkst, haʊ mʌtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 勝利之杯接著要問冰，要多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice talk after that? My head spins.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs tɔk ˈæftɚ ðæt? maɪ hɛd spɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 接下來就輪到冰？我都快暈了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spin gently, the ice chart is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɪn ˈdʒɛntli, ði aɪs tʃɑrt ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉就好，冰的選項很少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three options, I survived worse today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈɑpʃənz, aɪ sɚˈvaɪvd wɜrs təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 三個選項，我今天撐得過更難的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let us face the ice together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs feɪs ði aɪs təˈɡɛðɚ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們一起面對冰塊這一關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now the ice part, go slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, naʊ ði aɪs pɑrt, ɡoʊ sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，接著是冰的部分，慢慢說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No stress, start with how cold you like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ strɛs, stɑrt wɪð haʊ koʊld ju laɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 別緊張，先說你有多愛冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Normal ice means the cup full of cubes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔrməl aɪs minz ðə kʌp fʊl əv kjubz?/
dialogue.zh: 正常冰就是杯子塞滿冰塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About half clear tea, half ice cubes.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt hæf klɪr ti, hæf aɪs kjubz./
dialogue.zh: 大概一半是茶，一半是冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less ice, so that is the greedy choice?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs aɪs, soʊ ðæt ɪz ðə ˈɡridi tʃɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 少冰，其實是最貪心的選法？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the practical one, more tea for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈpræktɪkəl wʌn, mɔr ti fɚ ju./
dialogue.zh: 其實是務實的那個，茶給你更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much more tea does less give?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ mɔr ti dʌz lɛs ɡɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 少冰能多帶來多少茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roughly three extra sips of tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌfli θri ˈɛkstrə sɪps əv ti./
dialogue.zh: 大約多得到三口的量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will say less ice and see for myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪ lɛs aɪs ænd si fɔr maɪˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 那我就點少冰，親自看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will love the bigger sips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl lʌv ðə ˈbɪɡɚ sɪps./
dialogue.zh: 你會愛上大口的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is very little ice called here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈlɪtəl aɪs kɔld hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡把幾乎不加冰叫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call it a kiss of ice, two cubes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kɔl ɪt ə kɪs əv aɪs, tu kjubz./
dialogue.zh: 我們叫它「微冰」，只放兩塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A kiss of ice sounds like poetry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɪs əv aɪs saʊndz laɪk poʊˈɛtri./
dialogue.zh: 「冰的一吻」，聽起來像詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order life needs small poems sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrdɚ laɪf nidz smɔl ˈpoʊəmz ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 點單的生活，偶爾需要小詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a kiss of ice stay cold walking home?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə kɪs əv aɪs steɪ koʊld ˈwɔkɪŋ hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 微冰的話，走路回家還冷得住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not long, a kiss melts within fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt lɔŋ, ə kɪs mɛlts wɪˈθɪn ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 撐不久，十來分鐘就化光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen? My walk home takes twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin? maɪ wɔk hoʊm teɪks ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘？我走路回家要二十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then normal ice is your travel friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈnɔrməl aɪs ɪz jʊr ˈtrævəl frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 那正常冰才是你路上的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Travel friend, I will write that down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrævəl frɛnd, aɪ wɪl raɪt ðæt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 路上的朋友，這句我要記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poems and notes, you are a strange customer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpoʊəmz ænd noʊts, ju ɑr ə streɪndʒ ˈkʌstəmɚ./
dialogue.zh: 又寫詩又做筆記，你真是個奇怪的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strange but happy, that is the goal.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪndʒ bʌt ˈhæpi, ðæt ɪz ðə ɡoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 奇怪但快樂，就是我的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy guests return, so strange is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi ɡɛsts rɪˈtɜrn, soʊ streɪndʒ ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 開心的客人會回流，奇怪沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I take none, is it room temperature?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ teɪk nʌn, ɪz ɪt rum ˈtɛmprətʃɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果完全去冰，是常溫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call it no ice, slightly cool tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kɔl ɪt noʊ aɪs, ˈslaɪtli kuːl ti./
dialogue.zh: 我們叫去冰，茶會微涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slightly cool is boring for July days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslaɪtli kuːl ɪz ˈbɔrɪŋ fɚ dʒʊˈlaɪ deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 微涼在七月的天氣太無聊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In July, even kids ask for full ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ, ˈivɪn kɪdz æsk fɚ fʊl aɪs./
dialogue.zh: 七月連小孩都點全冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is July hot today, so keep the ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz dʒʊˈlaɪ hɑt təˈdeɪ, soʊ kip ði aɪs./
dialogue.zh: 今天七月天熱，冰塊請留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then choose: normal or less cubes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðɛn tʃuz: ˈnɔrməl ɔr lɛs kjubz?/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就選：正常還是少冰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less ice, but not the kiss option.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs aɪs, bʌt nɑt ðə kɪs ˈɑpʃən./
dialogue.zh: 少冰，但不要微冰那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle road again, you are consistent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl roʊd əˈɡɛn, ju ɑr kənˈsɪstənt./
dialogue.zh: 又是中間路線，你還真前後一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Consistent with forty sugar too, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈsɪstənt wɪð ˈfɔrti ˈʃʊɡɚ tu, ˈæktʃuəli./
dialogue.zh: 其實也跟四成的糖度很一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Middle everything, that is a real style.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ, ðæt ɪz ə ril staɪl./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都要剛剛好，這就是一種風格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does less ice make the tea weaker?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz lɛs aɪs meɪk ðə ti ˈwikɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 少冰會讓茶變淡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, fewer cubes mean less melt.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈfjʊɚ kjubz min lɛs mɛlt./
dialogue.zh: 不會，冰越少，化進茶的越少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So less ice means slower water creep?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lɛs aɪs minz ˈsloʊwɚ ˈwɔtɚ krip?/
dialogue.zh: 所以少冰代表水來得更慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, big cubes melt slower too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, bɪɡ kjubz mɛlt ˈsloʊwɚ tu./
dialogue.zh: 對，大塊的冰也化得比較慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You think about ice all day, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɪŋk əˈbaʊt aɪs ɔl deɪ, hʌ?/
dialogue.zh: 妳整天都在想冰塊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten hours a shift, ice fills my dreams.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈaʊɚz ə ʃɪft, aɪs fɪlz maɪ drimz./
dialogue.zh: 一班十小時，冰塊填滿我的夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice dreams, now that is a movie title.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs drimz, naʊ ðæt ɪz ə ˈmuvi ˈtaɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 「冰塊之夢」，可以當電影片名了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A short one, with happy drinking endings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃɔrt wʌn, wɪð ˈhæpi ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ˈɛndɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 要很短，結局都是開心喝飲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half laugh, half sigh, my face right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf læf, hæf saɪ, maɪ feɪs raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 半笑半嘆氣，我現在的表情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect customer face, I know it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈkʌstəmɚ feɪs, aɪ noʊ ɪt wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 完美的顧客臉孔，我看過很多次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I skip ice in my fruit tea later?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ skɪp aɪs ɪn maɪ frut ti ˈleɪtɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 之後水果茶可以完全去冰嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit tea loves its ice, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /frut ti lʌvz ɪts aɪs, ˈɑnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 說實話，水果茶離不開冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But fruit tea without ice feels like what?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt frut ti wɪˈðaʊt aɪs filz laɪk wʌt?/
dialogue.zh: 但沒冰的水果茶像什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes like sun-warmed juice from a car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪsts laɪk sʌn ˈwɔrmd dʒus frʌm ə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 喝起來像曬過太陽、忘在車上的果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay okay, full respect for ice now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ oʊˈkeɪ, fʊl rɪˈspɛkt fɚ aɪs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好喔好喔，我現在給冰滿分尊重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice says thank you, sincerely.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs sɛz θæŋk ju, sɪnˈsɛrli./
dialogue.zh: 冰塊說，它誠摯地感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You make even cubes feel alive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪk ˈivɪn kjubz fil əˈlaɪv./
dialogue.zh: 你讓冰塊聽起來都有生命。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They bounce in the shaker, very alive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ baʊns ɪn ðə ˈʃekɚ, ˈvɛri əˈlaɪv./
dialogue.zh: 它們在搖杯裡跳動，超有活力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shaker? What happens in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʃekɚ? wʌt ˈhæpənz ɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 搖杯？裡面會發生什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea, syrup, ice, then a strong shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti, ˈsɪrəp, aɪs, ðɛn ə strɔŋ ʃeɪk./
dialogue.zh: 茶、糖水、冰，然後用力搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strong shake, like the salt shaker motion?
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ ʃeɪk, laɪk ðə sɔlt ˈʃekɚ ˈmoʊʃən?/
dialogue.zh: 用力搖，像搖鹽瓶那樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, ten hard shakes, until foam appears.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, tɛn hɑrd ʃeɪks, ʌnˈtɪl foʊm əˈpɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 不，用力搖十下，搖到冒泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foam from shaking? That is magic.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊm frʌm ˈʃeɪkɪŋ? ðæt ɪz ˈmædʒɪk./
dialogue.zh: 搖一搖就有泡？這是魔法吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just air and tea learning to hold hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ɛr ænd ti ˈlɜrnɪŋ tu hoʊld hændz./
dialogue.zh: 只是空氣跟茶學會了牽手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less ice then, but enough to shake loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs aɪs ðɛn, bʌt ɪˈnʌf tu ʃeɪk laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那就少冰，但夠讓搖杯大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, cubes also help mix the milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, kjubz ˈɔlsoʊ hɛlp mɪks ðə mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，冰塊也幫奶混勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, my splash needs a good tumble.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, maɪ splæʃ nidz ə ɡʊd ˈtʌmbəl./
dialogue.zh: 對，我那一淋奶需要好好翻滾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shaker gives every drop a ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʃekɚ ɡɪvz ˈɛvri drɑp ə raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 搖杯會讓每滴茶都搭便車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about hot drinks, no ice at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt hɑt drɪŋks, noʊ aɪs æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 那熱飲呢，完全不放冰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot cups skip ice, we steam the milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt kʌps skɪp aɪs, wi stim ðə mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 熱杯不給冰，奶會蒸熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steaming milk, now that feels cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstimɪŋ mɪlk, naʊ ðæt filz ˈkoʊzi./
dialogue.zh: 蒸熱的奶，聽起來好溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In winter, half our counter goes hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ˈwɪntɚ, hæf ɑʊr ˈkaʊntɚ ɡoʊz hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 冬天時，半個櫃台都是熱飲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half the shop hot in winter? Amazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðə ʃɑp hɑt ɪn ˈwɪntɚ? əˈmeɪzɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 冬天半間店都做熱的？太神奇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm hands, warm hearts, warm taro milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm hændz, wɔrm hɑrts, wɔrm ˈtɑroʊ mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 手心暖、心裡暖、熱芋頭奶也暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taro again, you really push that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɑroʊ əˈɡɛn, ju ˈrɪli pʊʃ ðæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 又是芋頭，你真的很推那杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only speak truth, the rest is tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli spik truθ, ðə rɛst ɪz ti./
dialogue.zh: 我只說真話，剩下都交給茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, deal, keep your taro secret safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ, dil, kip jʊr ˈtɑroʊ ˈsikrɪt seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 哈，成交，你的芋頭祕密我保管。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Secret stored, your ice note: less cubes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsikrɪt stɔrd, jʊr aɪs noʊt: lɛs kjubz./
dialogue.zh: 祕密收好了，你的冰塊紀錄：少冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less cubes, that phrase is now mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs kjubz, ðæt freɪz ɪz naʊ maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 「少冰塊」，這句話現在是我的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it anywhere, tea people will nod.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt ˈɛnɪwɛr, ti ˈpipəl wɪl nɑd./
dialogue.zh: 在哪裡說都行，同好會跟你點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice done. What is left on the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs dʌn. wʌt ɪz lɛft ɑn ðə lɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 冰決定了。清單上還剩什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toppings, sizes, then your number tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɑpɪŋz, ˈsaɪzɪz, ðɛn jʊr ˈnʌmbɚ tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 加料、杯大小，然後是取貨號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toppings at last, I have been waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɑpɪŋz æt læst, aɪ hæv bɪn ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 終於到加料了，我等好久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good things arrive to those who queue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋz əˈraɪv tu ðoz hu kju./
dialogue.zh: 好東西會留給排隊的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number tag too? How does that work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚ tæɡ tu? haʊ dʌz ðæt wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 還有號碼牌？那是怎麼運作的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small pager buzzes when tea is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ˈpeɪdʒɚ ˈbʌzɪz wɛn ti ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 茶好了，小呼叫器就會震。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A buzzing pager, like a movie bomb?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbʌzɪŋ ˈpeɪdʒɚ, laɪk ə ˈmuvi bɑm?/
dialogue.zh: 會震的呼叫器，像電影裡的炸彈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A sweeter bomb, it bursts into drinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈswitɚ bɑm, ɪt bɜrstz ˈɪntu drɪŋks./
dialogue.zh: 比較甜的炸彈，一爆開變成飲品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bursts into drinks, you are dangerous.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɜrstz ˈɪntu drɪŋks, ju ɑr ˈdeɪndʒɚəs./
dialogue.zh: 爆成飲品，你這人滿危險的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dangerously friendly, mostly just tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪndʒɚəsli ˈfrɛndli, ˈmoʊstli dʒʌst ˈtaɪɚd./
dialogue.zh: 危險地友善，但大部分只是累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tired words, but I will take the joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪɚd wɜrdz, bʌt aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə dʒoʊk./
dialogue.zh: 聽起來好累，但這笑話我收下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jokes free, like the sugar fixes today.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒoʊks fri, laɪk ðə ˈʃʊɡɚ ˈfɪksɪz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 笑話免費，像今天的改糖服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice settled, pearls enter the story.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs ˈsɛtəld, pɜrlz ˈɛntɚ ðə ˈstɔri./
dialogue.zh: 冰搞定，珍珠要進場了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chapter after ice, my favorite page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃæptɚ ˈæftɚ aɪs, maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 冰之後的那一章，也是我最愛的一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chapter four of the ordering book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃæptɚ fɔr əv ði ˈɔrdərɪŋ bʊk./
dialogue.zh: 這是「點單之書」的第四章。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Written fresh daily, page by page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtən frɛʃ ˈdeɪli, peɪdʒ baɪ peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 每天新寫一頁，從不懈怠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, about pearls, are they cooked fresh?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst əˈbaʊt pɜrlz, ɑr ðeɪ kʊkt frɛʃ./
dialogue.zh: 先說珍珠，它們是現煮的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one fresh pot cooks every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn frɛʃ pɑt kʊks ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 對，每天早上現煮一鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old pearls cannot be saved for later?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld pɜrlz ˈkænɑt bi seɪvd fɔr ˈleɪtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 放著的舊珍珠不能再用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they turn hard, so we start clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðeɪ tɜrn hɑrd, soʊ wi stɑrt klin./
dialogue.zh: 會變硬，所以我們從新鍋開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean pots, clean cup, clean everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin pɑts, klin kʌp, klin ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的鍋、乾淨的杯、什麼都乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The house rule stitched inside our aprons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə haʊs rul stɪtʃt ɪnˈsaɪd ɑʊr ˈeɪpɚnz./
dialogue.zh: 店裡的規矩就縫在圍裙裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your aprons keep more secrets than banks.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈeɪpɚnz kip mɔr ˈsikrɪts ðæn bæŋks./
dialogue.zh: 你們的圍裙比銀行藏更多祕密。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bank vaults are colder, our tea is softer.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæŋk vɔlts ɑr ˈkoʊldɚ, ɑʊr ti ɪz ˈsɔftɚ./
dialogue.zh: 金庫比較冷，我們的茶比較軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That line deserves applause, plus one pearl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪn dɪˈzɜrvz əˈplɔz, plʌs wʌn pɜrl./
dialogue.zh: 這句話值得掌聲，外加一顆珍珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clap clap, now let us pick your toppings.
dialogue.phonetic: /klæp klæp, naʊ lɛt ʌs pɪk jʊr ˈtɑpɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 拍拍手，來挑你的加料吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toppings time, my spoon is already hungry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɑpɪŋz taɪm, maɪ spun ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈhʌŋɡri./
dialogue.zh: 加料時間，我的胖勺子已經餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hungry spoon, meet the pearl station soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌŋɡri spun, mit ðə pɜrl ˈsteɪʃən sun./
dialogue.zh: 餓了的勺子，馬上帶你見珍珠站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pearl station looks like a candy bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɜrl ˈsteɪʃən lʊks laɪk ə ˈkændi bɑr./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠區看起來像一條糖果吧檯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six toppings glow under those lamps.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈtɑpɪŋz ɡloʊ ˈʌndɚ ðoz læmpz./
dialogue.zh: 六種配料在那盞燈下發亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Classic black pearls, how are they made?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk blæk pɜrlz, haʊ ɑr ðeɪ meɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 經典黑珍珠是怎麼做的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tapioca dough, rolled, cut, then simmered.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌtæpiˈoʊkə doʊ, roʊld, kʌt, ðɛn ˈsɪmərd./
dialogue.zh: 樹薯粉團，搓條、切塊、再慢煮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simmered in brown sugar, I hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmərd ɪn braʊn ˈʃʊɡɚ, aɪ hoʊp./
dialogue.zh: 希望是用黑糖水慢慢煨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they bathe in sweet syrup all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ bæð ɪn swit ˈsɪrəp ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，它們整天泡在糖漿裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one batch of pearls cook?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz wʌn bætʃ əv pɜrlz kʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 一鍋珍珠要煮多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes boil, thirty minutes rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts bɔɪl, ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 煮三十分，再悶三十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An hour for pearls? Worth every minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ˈaʊɚ fɚ pɜrlz? wɜrθ ˈɛvri ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一顆珍珠一個鐘頭？值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old hands say fresh pearls change the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld hændz seɪ frɛʃ pɜrlz tʃeɪndʒ ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 老師傅說，現煮珍珠會整個升級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the golden mini pearls?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si ðə ˈɡoʊldən ˈmɪni pɜrlz?/
dialogue.zh: 可以讓我看看黃金小珍珠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small ones, cute, they hide and surprise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl wʌnz, kjuːt, ðeɪ haɪd ænd sɚˈpraɪz./
dialogue.zh: 小小一顆很可愛，會躲起來給你驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mini pearls fit better in a thin straw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪni pɜrlz fɪt ˈbɛtɚ ɪn ə θɪn strɔ./
dialogue.zh: 小珍珠比較適合細吸管。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, big pearls need the wide straw.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, bɪɡ pɜrlz nid ðə waɪd strɔ./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，大珍珠非粗吸管不可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me the wide straw, no doubt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ðə waɪd strɔ, noʊ daʊt./
dialogue.zh: 那就給我粗吸管，毫無疑問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wide straw, classic pearls, a strong start.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪd strɔ, ˈklæsɪk pɜrlz, ə strɔŋ stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 粗吸管配黑珍珠，很好的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are pearls counted or scooped by feel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr pɜrlz ˈkaʊntɪd ɔr skupt baɪ fil?/
dialogue.zh: 珍珠是一顆顆數，還是用感覺舀？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One ladle per cup, no counting needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈleɪdəl pɜr kʌp, noʊ ˈkaʊntɪŋ ˈnidɪd./
dialogue.zh: 一杯一杓，不用數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ladle sounds dramatic for sugar balls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪdəl saʊndz drəˈmætɪk fɚ ˈʃʊɡɚ bɔlz./
dialogue.zh: 用杓子舀糖球，聽起來好隆重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are serious sugar balls, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr ˈsɪriəs ˈʃʊɡɚ bɔlz, trʌst mi./
dialogue.zh: 這些糖球很認真，請相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about pudding, is it house-made?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈpʊdɪŋ, ɪz ɪt haʊs meɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 布丁呢，是店內自己做的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every day before sunrise, we steam it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri deɪ bɪˈfɔr ˈsʌnˌraɪz, wi stim ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 每天日出前開始蒸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steamed pudding means very smooth, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /stimd ˈpʊdɪŋ minz ˈvɛri smuð, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 蒸出來的布丁就是滑，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Egg, milk, a little sugar, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛɡ, mɪlk, ə ˈlɪtəl ˈʃʊɡɚ, ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 蛋、牛奶、一點糖，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three ingredients, and it tastes rich.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɪnˈɡridiənts, ænd ɪt teɪsts rɪtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 三種材料，卻吃起來很高級。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rich but gentle, it melts on the tongue.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪtʃ bʌt ˈdʒɛntəl, ɪt mɛlts ɑn ðə tʌŋ./
dialogue.zh: 濃郁但溫柔，在舌尖化開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pudding or pearls, do I really choose?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊdɪŋ ɔr pɜrlz, du aɪ ˈrɪli tʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 布丁還是珍珠，真的只能選一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No force today, you may take both.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fɔrs təˈdeɪ, ju meɪ teɪk boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 今天不用被逼，兩個都要也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both? Is there even room in my cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ? ɪz ðɛr ˈivɪn rum ɪn maɪ kʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 兩個都要？杯子放得下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stack pudding first, pearls dive after.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stæk ˈpʊdɪŋ fɜrst, pɜrlz daɪv ˈæftɚ./
dialogue.zh: 布丁先墊底，珍珠接著跳下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pearls dive through pudding, cinematic.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrlz daɪv θru ˈpʊdɪŋ, ˌsɪnəˈmætɪk./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠穿過布丁往下沉，像電影畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free cinema, the second topping is cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈsɪnəmə, ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈtɑpɪŋ ɪz tʃip./
dialogue.zh: 免費電影，第二樣加料又便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second topping cheap? Tell me prices.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd ˈtɑpɪŋ tʃip? tɛl mi ˈpraɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 第二樣便宜？報個價吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First extra is one dollar, the second is half.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ˈɛkstrə ɪz wʌn ˈdɑlɚ, ðə ˈsɛkənd ɪz hæf./
dialogue.zh: 第一樣加一塊，第二樣半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pearls plus pudding, then how much total?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrlz plʌs ˈpʊdɪŋ, ðɛn haʊ mʌtʃ ˈtoʊtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 珍珠加布丁，總共多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dollar fifty in total, cheap fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈdɑlɚ ˈfɪfti ɪn ˈtoʊtəl, tʃip fʌn./
dialogue.zh: 一共一塊五，很划算的快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap fun is my favorite economy.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip fʌn ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt ɪˈkɑnəmi./
dialogue.zh: 便宜的快樂是我最愛的經濟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add grass jelly and we reach luxury.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ɡræs ˈdʒɛli ænd wi ritʃ ˈlʌɡʒəri./
dialogue.zh: 再加仙草，就摸到奢華的邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grass jelly sounds like a lawn drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræs ˈdʒɛli saʊndz laɪk ə lɔn drɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 仙草聽起來像在喝草坪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes from a plant, cooled to jelly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʌmz frʌm ə plænt, kʊld tu ˈdʒɛli./
dialogue.zh: 它來自一種草，涼成凍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plant jelly, dark and wobbly, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /plænt ˈdʒɛli, dɑrk ænd ˈwɑbli, ɡɑt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 植物做的凍，黑黑軟彈，明白了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It cools the throat, great for hot days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʊlz ðə θroʊt, ɡreɪt fɚ hɑt deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 它讓喉嚨涼下來，熱天首選。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cup already has pearls and pudding.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kʌp ɔlˈrɛdi hæz pɜrlz ænd ˈpʊdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我的杯裡已經有珍珠和布丁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A third scoop of jelly would be bold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θɜrd skup ɑv ˈdʒɛli wʊd bi boʊld./
dialogue.zh: 再加第三樣仙草，就會很大膽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tempting, but my wallet watches nervously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛmptɪŋ, bət maɪ ˈwɑlət ˈwɑtʃɪz ˈnɜrvəsli./
dialogue.zh: 很誘人，但我的錢包在旁邊緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wise choice, the wallet forgives a small no.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪz tʃɔɪs, ðə ˈwɑlət fərˈɡɪvz ə smɔl noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，錢包會原諒一個小小的不。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coconut cubes are another option here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkoʊkəˌnʌt kjubz ɑr əˈnʌðɚ ˈɑpʃən hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 椰子凍也是選項之一嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they hide under pearls like treasure.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ haɪd ˈʌndɚ pɜrlz laɪk ˈtrɛʒɚ./
dialogue.zh: 對，它們像寶藏躲在珍珠下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Treasure pearls need a pirate straw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrɛʒɚ pɜrlz nid ə ˈpaɪrət strɔ./
dialogue.zh: 藏寶珍珠需要一根海盜吸管。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wide straw is your pirate ship.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə waɪd strɔ ɪz jʊr ˈpaɪrət ʃɪp./
dialogue.zh: 那根粗吸管就是你的海盜船。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sail ho, extra pearls on my cup!
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪl hoʊ, ˈɛkstrə pɜrlz ɑn maɪ kʌp!/
dialogue.zh: 揚帆！我的杯要加雙倍珍珠！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Double pearls, coming up with a swish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌbəl pɜrlz, ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp wɪð ə swɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 雙倍珍珠，一杓颼地進杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swish sounds like money leaving fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪʃ saʊndz laɪk ˈmʌni ˈlivɪŋ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 颼一聲，像錢跑很快的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow leak, just fifty cents, captain.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ lik, dʒʌst ˈfɪfti sɛnts, ˈkæptɪn./
dialogue.zh: 只是慢慢漏，五十分而已，船長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain airdrops into the topping bay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptɪn ˈɛrˌdrɑps ˈɪntu ðə ˈtɑpɪŋ beɪ./
dialogue.zh: 船長空降進加料灣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bay is open, choose your final cargo.
dialogue.phonetic: /beɪ ɪz ˈoʊpən, tʃuz jʊr ˈfaɪnəl ˈkɑrɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 港口開放，選你最後的貨物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cargo list: pearls, pudding, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑrɡoʊ lɪst: pɜrlz, ˈpʊdɪŋ, ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 貨單：珍珠、布丁，其他不要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good captain, that load is perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈkæptɪn, ðæt loʊd ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 好船長，這載重剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect load, seal the cup tight please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt loʊd, sil ðə kʌp taɪt pliz./
dialogue.zh: 滿載而穩，請把杯口封緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine presses the film with a hum.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin ˈprɛsɪz ðə fɪlm wɪð ə hʌm./
dialogue.zh: 封膜機嗡一聲就壓好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hum, and my tea wears a silver hat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hʌm, ænd maɪ ti wɛrz ə ˈsɪlvɚ hæt./
dialogue.zh: 嗡一聲，我的茶戴上了銀帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sealed hats keep sips inside on walks.
dialogue.phonetic: /siːld hæts kip sɪps ɪnˈsaɪd ɑn wɔks./
dialogue.zh: 封好的帽子，讓茶留在杯裡陪你走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is the pudding still at the bottom?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ɪz ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ stɪl æt ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 等等，布丁還在杯底嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom first, so every sip meets it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm fɜrst, soʊ ˈɛvri sɪp miːts ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 布丁墊底，每口都遇到它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every sip meeting pudding, beautiful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri sɪp ˈmitɪŋ ˈpʊdɪŋ, ˈbjutəfəl./
dialogue.zh: 每一口都會吻到布丁，太美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugly truth: pudding cracks while shaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌɡli truθ: ˈpʊdɪŋ kræks waɪl ˈʃeɪkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 醜陋的真相：搖的時候布丁會裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cracked pudding changes the texture?
dialogue.phonetic: /krækt ˈpʊdɪŋ ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ðə ˈtɛkstʃɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 裂開的布丁會改變口感嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Makes ribbons, tea tastes creamier after.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks ˈrɪbənz, ti teɪsts ˈkrimiɚ ˈæftɚ./
dialogue.zh: 變成一條條，茶反而更奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ribbon tea, new art form discovered.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪbən ti, nu ɑrt fɔrm dɪˈskʌvɚd./
dialogue.zh: 緞帶茶，新的藝術形式誕生了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it in our break room someday.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt ɪn ɑʊr breɪk rum ˈsʌmˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 改天掛到我們休息室去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your break room is fancy, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr breɪk rum ɪz ˈfænsi, aɪ si./
dialogue.zh: 看來你們休息室很有品味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One painting, three chairs, endless tea talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈpeɪntɪŋ, θri tʃɛrz, ˈɛndləs ti tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 一幅畫、三張椅、聊不完的茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Endless tea talk explains the good service.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛndləs ti tɔk ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə ɡʊd ˈsɜrvɪs./
dialogue.zh: 聊不完的茶，解釋了你們的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We practice chatting while shaking cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈpræktɪs ˈtʃætɪŋ waɪl ˈʃeɪkɪŋ kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 我們邊搖杯邊練習聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chat and shake, the double skill job.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃæt ænd ʃeɪk, ðə ˈdʌbəl skɪl dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 又聊又搖，這是雙技能的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody claps, but the tea notices.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi klæps, bʌt ðə ti ˈnoʊtɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 沒人鼓掌，但茶會感覺到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea notices, that line is gold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti ˈnoʊtɪsɪz, ðæt laɪn ɪz ɡoʊld./
dialogue.zh: 茶會感覺到，這句話是金的。
