dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like the golden foam ring on pudding.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðə ˈɡoʊldən foʊm rɪŋ ɑn ˈpʊdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 像布丁邊緣那圈金色奶泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pudding wears a crown, pearls bow low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊdɪŋ wɛrz ə kraʊn, pɜrlz baʊ loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 布丁戴王冠，珍珠低頭行禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Royal cup, you drink as royalty now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɔɪəl kʌp, ju drɪŋk æz ˈrɔɪəlti naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 皇室之杯，你現在是皇室喝法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Royalty needs the right cup size though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɔɪəlti nidz ðə raɪt kʌp saɪz ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過皇室也要選對杯量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the size question, a royal moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ, ðə saɪz ˈkwɛstʃən, ə ˈrɔɪəl ˈmoʊmənt./
dialogue.zh: 啊，尺寸之問，正是皇室的時刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Large looks huge from up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑrdʒ lʊks hjudʒ frʌm ʌp hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 從這裡看，大杯真的好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds two hundred more inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz tu ˈhʌndrəd mɔr ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 它多裝兩百毫升在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lot to carry home in this heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɑt tə ˈkæri hoʊm ɪn ðɪs hit./
dialogue.zh: 這麼多茶，大熱天還要提回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, the big cup warms on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, ðə bɪɡ kʌp wɔrmz ɑn ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 真的，大杯在路上就變溫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meanwhile, my mind is already at the straw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈminwaɪl, maɪ maɪnd ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi æt ðə strɔ./
dialogue.zh: 同時，我的腦子已經跳到吸管那一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Care and courage, that is the whole trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛr ænd ˈkɜrɪdʒ, ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl trɪk./
dialogue.zh: 溫柔加勇氣，就是全部的訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One clean push, then a pearl rides up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klin pʊʃ, ðɛn ə pɜrl raɪdz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 乾淨地一推，一顆珍珠就搭上來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That push is everyone's small victory.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pʊʃ ɪz ˈɛvriˌwʌnz smɔl ˈvɪktəri./
dialogue.zh: 那一下，是每個人的小勝利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We celebrate tiny wins in this shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈsɛləˌbreɪt ˈtaɪni wɪnz ɪn ðɪs ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 這家店連小小的勝利都慶祝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wins stack up like pearls in a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnz stæk ʌp laɪk pɜrlz ɪn ə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 勝利會像珍珠一樣堆在杯底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pearl math, I never expected homework here.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrl mæθ, aɪ ˈnɛvɚ ɪkˈspɛkˌtɪd ˈhoʊmˌwɜrk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠數學，我沒預期要在這做作業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Homework free, sizes are up next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhoʊmˌwɜrk fri, ˈsaɪzɪz ɑr ʌp nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 免寫作業，下一題是尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sizes: medium and large, what else exists?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪzɪz: ˈmidiəm ænd lɑrdʒ, wʌt ɛls ɪɡˈzɪsts?/
dialogue.zh: 尺寸：中杯大杯，還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small kids cup, mostly for puddings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl kɪdz kʌp, ˈmoʊstli fɚ ˈpʊdɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 還有一種兒童小杯，多半裝布丁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids size with pearls? A snack in a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz saɪz wɪð pɜrlz? ə snæk ɪn ə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 兒童杯加珍珠？一杯點心呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, half drink, half treasure box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, hæf drɪŋk, hæf ˈtrɛʒɚ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，一半飲料，一半寶箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, my proper size, let us compare.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, maɪ ˈprɑpɚ saɪz, lɛt ʌs kəmˈpɛr./
dialogue.zh: 好，屬於我的容量，來比較一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium or large, let me show both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm ɔr lɑrdʒ, lɛt mi ʃoʊ boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 中杯或大杯，我拿兩個給你看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold up both cups, let me look.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ʌp boʊθ kʌps, lɛt mi lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 把兩個杯子舉起來，讓我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium here, large right beside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm hɪr, lɑrdʒ raɪt bɪˈsaɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 中杯在這裡，大杯就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the big one looks really tall.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðə bɪɡ wʌn lʊks ˈrɪli tɔl./
dialogue.zh: 好啦，大杯那個看起來真的很高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Large holds seven hundred, medium five.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑrdʒ hoʊldz ˈsɛvən ˈhʌndrəd, ˈmidiəm faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 大杯七百毫升，中杯五百。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred difference, that is real.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈdɪfərəns, ðæt ɪz ril./
dialogue.zh: 差兩百，這是有感的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real tea inside, not just a taller cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril ti ɪnˈsaɪd, nɑt dʒʌst ə ˈtɔlɚ kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 是真的茶變多，不只是杯子高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the price gap between them?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə praɪs ɡæp bɪˈtwin ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 兩者價差是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dollar lifts you from medium up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈdɑlɚ lɪfts ju frʌm ˈmidiəm ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 加一塊錢，就從中杯飛上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One dollar for two hundred more?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈdɑlɚ fɚ tu ˈhʌndrəd mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 一塊錢，多兩百毫升？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Math approved, the large is the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæθ əˈpruːvd, ðə lɑrdʒ ɪz ðə dil./
dialogue.zh: 數學核可，大杯最划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But deals have tricked me before.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt dilz hæv trɪkt mi bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 但划算騙過我好幾次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What happened last time you upgraded?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənd læst taɪm ju ˈʌpˌɡreɪdɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 上次升級大杯時發生了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ordered large, left half untouched.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔrdɚd lɑrdʒ, lɛft hæf ʌnˈtʌtʃt./
dialogue.zh: 我點大杯，喝到一半就放著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too much ice melted, I bet.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌtʃ aɪs mɛltɪd, aɪ bɛt./
dialogue.zh: 我賭，是冰化過頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, a large betrays slow drinkers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ə lɑrdʒ bɪˈtreɪz sloʊ ˈdrɪŋkɚz./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，大杯會出賣慢喝的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then medium respects your slow sipping.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈmidiəm rɪˈspɛkts jʊr sloʊ ˈsɪpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那中杯會尊重你的小口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Respect, that is the first time for my cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈspɛkt, ðæt ɪz ðə fɜrst taɪm fɚ maɪ kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 被尊重，我的杯子頭一回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cups deserve respect, they work all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌps dɪˈzɜrv rɪˈspɛkt, ðeɪ wɜrk ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 杯子也值得一個尊重，它們全天在崗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How full is the medium with toppings?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fʊl ɪz ðə ˈmidiəm wɪð ˈtɑpɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 中杯加了料之後會多滿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pearls and pudding take up honest space.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrlz ænd ˈpʊdɪŋ teɪk ʌp ˈɑnɪst speɪs./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠布丁很誠實地佔位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So less real tea fits inside then?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lɛs ril ti fɪts ɪnˈsaɪd ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那中杯裡的茶就變少了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tea stops sooner, so pace yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti stɑps ˈsuːnɚ, soʊ peɪs jʊrˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 茶比較早見底，請控制節奏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pace myself, I like the idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪs maɪˈsɛlf, aɪ laɪk ði aɪˈdiə./
dialogue.zh: 控制節奏，我喜歡這個提議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finish proud, not finish stuffed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnɪʃ praʊd, nɑt ˈfɪnɪʃ stʌft./
dialogue.zh: 剛好喝完的驕傲，不是撐到飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need that on a poster.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ðæt ɑn ə ˈpoʊstɚ./
dialogue.zh: 這句話我要貼在海報上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sell posters, ask at the register.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛl ˈpoʊstɚz, æsk æt ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我們有賣海報，結帳時問一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The register, yes, money part comes soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstɚ, jɛs, ˈmʌni pɑrt kʌmz sun./
dialogue.zh: 收銀台，對，接下來就是錢的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First size, then coins, then your tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst saɪz, ðɛn kɔɪnz, ðɛn jʊr tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 先選尺寸，再付錢，再拿號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins, cards, or that phone tap thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz, kɑrdz, ɔr ðæt foʊn tæp θɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 現金、卡片，還是手機感應？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All accepted, the tap is fastest here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ɪkˈsɛptɪd, ðə tæp ɪz ˈfæstɪst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 都收，感應是最快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to sizes, which one do you take?
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tə ˈsaɪzɪz, wɪtʃ wʌn du ju teɪk./
dialogue.zh: 說回尺寸，你自己都喝哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium always, every single shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm ˈɔlweɪz, ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl ʃɪft./
dialogue.zh: 永遠是中杯，一個班都不換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you sip while you are on duty?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju sɪp waɪl ju ɑr ɑn ˈduti?/
dialogue.zh: 所以你值班的時候也會喝？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups daily, hidden behind the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps ˈdeɪli, ˈhɪdən bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkaʊntɚ./
dialogue.zh: 每天兩杯，都躲在櫃台後喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hidden tea breaks, that is adult life.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪdən ti breɪks, ðæt ɪz əˈdʌlt laɪf./
dialogue.zh: 躲起來喝茶，這就是大人的世界。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Little breaks keep the whole crew happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl breɪks kip ðə hoʊl kru ˈhæpi./
dialogue.zh: 小休息讓整個團隊都開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Happy crew, better tea, I agree.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi kru, ˈbɛtɚ ti, aɪ əˈɡri./
dialogue.zh: 團隊開心，茶就好喝，我同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now choose, my stopwatch is imaginary.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ tʃuz, maɪ ˈstɑpˌwɑtʃ ɪz ɪˈmædʒɪˌnɛri./
dialogue.zh: 現在選吧，我的讀秒計時器是假的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That stopwatch makes me laugh again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈstɑpˌwɑtʃ meɪks mi læf əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那個假計時器又把我逗笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third laugh, we are building a record.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd læf, wi ɑr ˈbɪldɪŋ ə ˈrɛkɚd./
dialogue.zh: 第三次了，我們快破紀錄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Record for laughing during a tea order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛkɚd fɚ ˈlæfɪŋ dʊˈrɪŋ ə ti ˈɔrdɚ./
dialogue.zh: 點茶時笑最多的人類紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are already on the wall of fame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn ðə wɔl əv feɪm./
dialogue.zh: 你已經登上本店的名人堂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wall of fame at a bubble tea shop!
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔl əv feɪm æt ə ˈbʌbəl ti ʃɑp!/
dialogue.zh: 手搖飲店的名人堂！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small world, big feelings, medium cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wɜrld, bɪɡ ˈfilɪŋz, ˈmidiəm kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 小店江湖，情感很大杯，中杯剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium you say, like reading my mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm ju seɪ, laɪk ˈridɪŋ maɪ maɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 你也覺得中杯，像在讀我的心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow sipper, forty sugar, mind is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ˈsɪpɚ, ˈfɔrti ˈʃʊɡɚ, maɪnd ɪz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 慢飲派加四成糖，你的心很好讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind reading aside, show me the large again.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnd ˈridɪŋ əˈsaɪd, ʃoʊ mi ðə lɑrdʒ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 先別讀心，再舉一次大杯給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, tall friend, cold, proud, generous.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, tɔl frɛnd, koʊld, praʊd, ˈdʒɛnɚəs./
dialogue.zh: 來，高個兒朋友，冷、傲、大方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tall friend tempts me, but no.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔl frɛnd tɛmpts mi, bʌt noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 高個兒朋友在引誘我，但不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wisdom today, the tall friend can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪzdəm təˈdeɪ, ðə tɔl frɛnd kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今天選中杯是明智，大杯等得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That plan is set, oolong time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt plæn ɪz sɛt, ˈuˌlʊŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 這計畫我記下了，那時換烏龍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oolong large, I will pretend I forgot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈuˌlʊŋ lɑrdʒ, aɪ wɪl prɪˈtɛnd aɪ fɚˈɡɑt./
dialogue.zh: 大杯烏龍，我會假裝忘記這事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pretend harder, my secret stays yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪˈtɛnd ˈhɑrdɚ, maɪ ˈsikrɪt steɪz jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 請假裝得再像一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal sealed with an imaginary stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil siːld wɪð æn ɪˈmædʒɪˌnɛri stæmp./
dialogue.zh: 成交，蓋上一個想像的印章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stamped and done, medium is official.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæmpd ænd dʌn, ˈmidiəm ɪz əˈfɪʃəl./
dialogue.zh: 蓋章定案，中杯正式確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium jasmine, pearls, pudding, forty, less ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm ˈdʒæzmɪn, pɜrlz, ˈpʊdɪŋ, ˈfɔrti, lɛs aɪs./
dialogue.zh: 中杯茉莉，加珍珠布丁，四成糖，少冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard that twice, it sounded like a poem.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ðæt twaɪs, ɪt ˈsaʊndɪd laɪk ə ˈpoʊəm./
dialogue.zh: 我聽了兩遍，那唸起來像一首詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your order, your epic, one cup saga.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈɔrdɚ, jʊr ˈɛpɪk, wʌn kʌp ˈsæɡə./
dialogue.zh: 你的訂單，你的史詩，一杯傳奇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saga finished, what is the damage total?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsæɡə ˈfɪnɪʃt, wʌt ɪz ðə ˈdæmɪdʒ ˈtoʊtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 傳奇結束，總共要花多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just under seven, taxes included.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈʌndɚ ˈsɛvən, ˈtæksɪz ɪnˈkluːdɪd./
dialogue.zh: 七塊以內，稅都算進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under seven, my bank account exhales.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ˈsɛvən, maɪ bæŋk əˈkaʊnt ɪksˈheɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 七塊內，我的帳戶終於吐口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Accounts relax here, prices stay friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkaʊnts rɪˈlæks hɪr, ˈpraɪsɪz steɪ ˈfrɛndli./
dialogue.zh: 帳戶在這放鬆，價位一直友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friendly prices, dangerous for my wallet's plans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfrɛndli ˈpraɪsɪz, ˈdeɪndʒɚəs fɚ maɪ ˈwɑlɪts plænz./
dialogue.zh: 價位太友善，對我錢包的計畫很危險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wallets survive, memories stay longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑlɪts sɚˈvaɪv, ˈmɛməriz steɪ ˈlɔŋɡɚ./
dialogue.zh: 錢包會挺過去，回憶會留更久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deep line, I was not ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip laɪn, aɪ wʌz nɑt ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 好深一句，我完全沒準備。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep poetry for slow afternoons.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip poʊˈɛtri fɚ sloʊ ˌæftɚˈnuns./
dialogue.zh: 我的詩都留給慢的下午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This afternoon is officially slow for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˌæftɚˈnun ɪz əˈfɪʃəli sloʊ fɚ mi./
dialogue.zh: 這個下午正式成為我的慢時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then lean back, size part is finished.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lin bæk, saɪz pɑrt ɪz ˈfɪnɪʃt./
dialogue.zh: 那就靠一下，尺寸這一關結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finished sizes, entering the payment chapter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnɪʃt ˈsaɪzɪz, ˈɛntərɪŋ ðə ˈpeɪmənt ˈtʃæptɚ./
dialogue.zh: 尺寸完成，進入付款章節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chapter six, bring your card or tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃæptɚ sɪks, brɪŋ jʊr kɑrd ɔr tæp./
dialogue.zh: 第六章，請出示卡片或手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six chapters in, and one more to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈtʃæptɚz ɪn, ænd wʌn mɔr tə ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 六章過關，還剩最後一章。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Checkout, number tag, then the shaking lesson.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt, ˈnʌmbɚ tæɡ, ðɛn ðə ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ˈlɛsən./
dialogue.zh: 結帳、取號，然後是搖杯課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shaking lesson? That is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ˈlɛsən? ðæt ɪz nu tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 搖杯課？這我沒上過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free class, every cup attends tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri klæs, ˈɛvri kʌp əˈtɛndz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 免費課程，每杯今晚都要出席。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight, then. First, the medium stands firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt, ðɛn. fɜrst, ðə ˈmidiəm stændz fɜrm./
dialogue.zh: 那就今晚。先說，中杯站得穩穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Firm and proud, it waits for its label.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm ænd praʊd, ɪt weɪts fɔr ɪts ˈleɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 穩又傲，它等著被貼上標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A label now? It already looks like mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈleɪbəl naʊ? ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi lʊks laɪk maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 現在要貼標籤？它看起來已經是我的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty, less ice, and your number in ink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti, lɛs aɪs, ænd jʊr ˈnʌmbɚ ɪn ɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 四成、少冰，還有你的號碼，都用墨印上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name is missing, but numbers work here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ, bət ˈnʌmbɚz wɜrk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 沒有我的名字，不過在這裡有號碼就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ink on the cup, that is our handshake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪŋk ɑn ðə kʌp, ðæt ɪz ɑʊr ˈhændʃeɪk./
dialogue.zh: 杯上的墨跡，就是我們的握手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Handshake sealed, and I am spreading the word.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhændʃeɪk siːld, ænd aɪ æm ˈsprɛdɪŋ ðə wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 握手成交了，我要幫你們對外宣傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them pearls travel safely here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm pɜrlz ˈtrævəl ˈseɪfli hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 告訴大家，珍珠在這裡一路安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe pearls, careful sippers, all covered.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf pɜrlz, ˈkɛrfəl ˈsɪpɚz, ɔl ˈkʌvɚd./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠安全，慢喝的人也被照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Covered like your cup, lid tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvɚd laɪk jʊr kʌp, lɪd taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 照顧得跟你那杯一樣嚴實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lid is now the tightest thing here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɪd ɪz naʊ ðə ˈtaɪtɪst θɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我的杯蓋現在是全店最緊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight lids, looser moods, that is the goal.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt lɪdz, ˈlusɚ mudz, ðæt ɪz ðə ɡoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 蓋子擰緊，心情放鬆，就是目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Looser moods, I feel one arriving already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlusɚ mudz, aɪ fil wʌn əˈraɪvɪŋ ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 放鬆的心情，我感覺它來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, moods and cups both fill better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, mudz ænd kʌps boʊθ fɪl ˈbɛtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 好，心情和杯子都會裝更滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better and better, is it checkout yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ ænd ˈbɛtɚ, ɪz ɪt ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt jɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 越來越好，可以結帳了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, follow the line on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈfɑloʊ ðə laɪn ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，跟著地板上的線走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line ends right at this register.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn ɛndz raɪt æt ðɪs ˈrɛdʒɪstɚ./
dialogue.zh: 這條線就停在收銀台前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here at the screen, tap whenever you are ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr æt ðə skrin, tæp wɛnˈɛvɚ ju ɑr ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 到了螢幕前，準備好就貼卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen adds up, and the numbers climb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ædz ʌp, ænd ðə ˈnʌmbɚz klaɪm./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕在加總，數字一路往上跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two toppings, one medium, still under seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtɑpɪŋz, wʌn ˈmidiəm, stɪl ˈʌndɚ ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣加料、一個中杯，還是不到七塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Payment first, then the shaking lesson, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪmənt fɜrst, ðɛn ðə ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ˈlɛsən, dil?/
dialogue.zh: 先付錢，再上搖杯課，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, tap your card right on the square.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, tæp jʊr kɑrd raɪt ɑn ðə skwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 成交，把卡貼在那個方塊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The square glows blue, very friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skwɛr ɡloʊz blu, ˈvɛri ˈfrɛndli./
dialogue.zh: 方塊亮藍光，很友善的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue means ready, beep means approved.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu minz ˈrɛdi, bip minz əˈpruːvd./
dialogue.zh: 藍光代表準備好，嗶聲代表成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep! Did we just make history together?
dialogue.phonetic: /bip! dɪd wi dʒʌst meɪk ˈhɪstəri təˈɡɛðɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 嗶！我們剛剛一起創造歷史了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paid in full, history gets a number tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd ɪn fʊl, ˈhɪstəri ɡɛts ə ˈnʌmbɚ tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 款項結清，歷史會給你一個號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is my number on the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ ɑn ðə rɪˈsit?/
dialogue.zh: 收據上我的號碼是幾號？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-two, keep it safe for pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu, kip ɪt seɪf fɚ ˈpɪkˌʌp./
dialogue.zh: 四十二號，收好，等等來取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-two called out loud, or on a screen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu kɔld aʊt laʊd, ɔr ɑn ə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 四十二號是用喊的，還是出現在螢幕上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, we call it and flash it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ, wi kɔl ɪt ænd flæʃ ɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 兩個都會，喊號碼也會閃螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I wait for forty-two?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ weɪt fɚ ˈfɔrti tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我該在哪裡等四十二號？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The benches on the left, near the plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɛntʃɪz ɑn ðə lɛft, nɪr ðə plænt./
dialogue.zh: 左邊的長椅，靠近那盆植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big plant, easy to spot from there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ plænt, ˈizi tu spɑt frʌm ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那盆大植物，在那邊很好認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it also hides the napkin station.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ haɪdz ðə ˈnæpkɪn ˈsteɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 對，它還順便遮住紙巾區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Napkins free? Good to know the spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæpkɪnz fri? ɡʊd tu noʊ ðə spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 紙巾免費？知道位置就不慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, the pudding cup gets messy.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu, ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ kʌp ɡɛts ˈmɛsi./
dialogue.zh: 拿兩張吧，布丁杯會有點狼狽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long until my number sings?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ʌnˈtɪl maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ sɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 我的號碼多久會唱起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight minutes, the shaker is busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈmɪnɪts, ðə ˈʃekɚ ɪz ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 八分鐘，搖杯機忙著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight is fine, I will sit and watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɪz faɪn, aɪ wɪl sɪt ænd wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 八分鐘剛好，我坐著看就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screens play the numbers, look up often.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrinz pleɪ ðə ˈnʌmbɚz, lʊk ʌp ˈɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕會跑號碼，記得常抬頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look up, got it, my first time doing that.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ʌp, ɡɑt ɪt, maɪ fɜrst taɪm duɪŋ ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 抬頭，收到，我頭一回這麼做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A healthy habit, the shop approves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhɛlθi ˈhæbɪt, ðə ʃɑp əˈpruvz./
dialogue.zh: 健康的好習慣，本店核准了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the number ever get missed?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ˈɛvɚ ɡɛt mɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 號碼會不會有時候被漏掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, we remake it, just show your receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz, wi rɪˈmeɪk ɪt, dʒʌst ʃoʊ jʊr rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 偶爾會，我們重做一杯，出示收據就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remade free? Generous again today.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmeɪd fri? ˈdʒɛnɚəs əˈɡɛn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 免費重做？今天第二次大方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our theme today, yes, second time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr θim təˈdeɪ, jɛs, ˈsɛkənd taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 今天的主題就是大方，第二次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a bag, or is it fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə bæɡ, ɔr ɪz ɪt faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我需要袋子嗎，還是直接拿著就好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cup sweats, the bag keeps hands dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp swɛts, ðə bæɡ kips hændz draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 杯身會流汗，袋子讓手保持乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cup sweat, I never thought about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌp swɛt, aɪ ˈnɛvɚ θɔt əˈbaʊt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 杯子的汗，我從沒想過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New guests miss it, regulars grab a bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ɡɛsts mɪs ɪt, ˈrɛɡjəlɚz ɡræb ə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 新客人常忽略，老手都會拿袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bag, please, for the medium saga.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bæɡ, pliz, fɚ ðə ˈmidiəm ˈsæɡə./
dialogue.zh: 請給我一個袋子，裝我那杯傳奇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saga in a bag, handle folded neatly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsæɡə ɪn ə bæɡ, ˈhændəl ˈfoʊldɪd ˈnitli./
dialogue.zh: 傳奇入袋，提把摺得整整齊齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neatness, the last topping on service.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnitnəs, ðə læst ˈtɑpɪŋ ɑn ˈsɜrvɪs./
dialogue.zh: 整齊，是服務上最後的加料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We tie the bag with one quick knot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi taɪ ðə bæɡ wɪð wʌn kwɪk nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我們一個快結就把袋子繫好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A knot, like a tiny gift now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nɑt, laɪk ə ˈtaɪni ɡɪft naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 打了結，這下像份小禮物了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gift for yourself, you earned it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪft fɚ jʊrˈsɛlf, ju ɜrnd ɪt təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 就送給你自己，你今天值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do I keep this receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du aɪ kip ðɪs rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 這張收據我要留多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until pickup, then recycle it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈtɪl ˈpɪkˌʌp, ðɛn ˈraɪsəkəl ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 取到飲之前留著，然後回收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Recycle it where, is there a bin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈraɪsəkəl ɪt wɛr, ɪz ðɛr ə bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那回收丟哪裡，有桶子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, blue bin, right beside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, blu bɪn, raɪt bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有的，藍色的回收桶，就在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue bin, receipt, knot, I am organized.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu bɪn, rɪˈsit, nɑt, aɪ æm ˈɔrɡəˌnaɪzd./
dialogue.zh: 藍桶、收據、結，我有條有理了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Organized guests make calm counters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrɡəˌnaɪzd ɡɛsts meɪk kɑm ˈkaʊntɚz./
dialogue.zh: 有條有理的客人，讓櫃台平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-two not singing yet, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu nɑt ˈsɪŋɪŋ jɛt, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 四十二號還沒唱，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, four numbers ahead of you still.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, fɔr ˈnʌmbɚz əˈhɛd əv ju stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 還沒，你前面還卡著四個號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four ahead, so six more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr əˈhɛd, soʊ sɪks mɔr ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 還差四個號，那就是六分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About that, watch the screen flicker.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ðæt, wɑtʃ ðə skrin ˈflɪkɚ./
dialogue.zh: 差不多，注意螢幕閃動就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen flickers like old televisions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ˈflɪkɚz laɪk oʊld ˈtɛləˌvɪʒənz./
dialogue.zh: 那螢幕閃得像老電視。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineties style, we did not choose it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪntiz staɪl, wi dɪd nɑt tʃuz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 九零年代風，我們說了不算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend waits outside, we share today.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd weɪts ˌaʊtˈsaɪd, wi ʃɛr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我朋友在外面等，我們今天分一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One medium split? That is a real plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmidiəm splɪt? ðæt ɪz ə ril plæn./
dialogue.zh: 一個中杯兩個人分？這規畫很認真。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Screen! Forty-one is going dark now.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrin! ˈfɔrti wʌn ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ dark naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 看螢幕！四十一號剛剛熄掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your turn approaches, get ready to stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr tɜrn əˈproʊtʃɪz, ɡɛt ˈrɛdi tu stænd./
dialogue.zh: 輪到你的那一刻快到了，準備起身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing, bag in hand, heart steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ, bæɡ ɪn hænd, hɑrt ˈstɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 站起來，袋在手上，心跳穩穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-two! That is your number singing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu! ðæt ɪz jʊr ˈnʌmbɚ ˈsɪŋɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 四十二！你的號碼正在唱歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hearing it is strangely moving, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪrɪŋ ɪt ɪz ˈstreɪndʒli ˈmuvɪŋ, frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 聽到號碼，莫名有點感動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go get your saga, counter on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɡɛt jʊr ˈsæɡə, ˈkaʊntɚ ɑn ðə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 去領你的傳奇吧，櫃台在右邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right counter, confirm name or number?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈkaʊntɚ, kənˈfɜrm neɪm ɔr ˈnʌmbɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 右邊櫃台，要報名字還是號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number only, show them the small receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚ ˈoʊnli, ʃoʊ ðɛm ðə smɔl rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 號碼就好，把小收據給他們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is forty-two, folded and all.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ˈfɔrti tu, ˈfoʊldɪd ænd ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 四十二號收據，摺得整整的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cup waiting on the pickup shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌp ˈweɪtɪŋ ɑn ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 杯子在取貨架上等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pickup shelf, fancy hotel for cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp ʃɛlf, ˈfænsi hoʊˈtɛl fɚ kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 取貨架，杯子的高級飯店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five-star shelf, room service included.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv stɑr ʃɛlf, rum ˈsɜrvɪs ɪnˈkluːdɪd./
dialogue.zh: 五星級架子，還附送餐到府服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room service is me carrying it home.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum ˈsɜrvɪs ɪz mi ˈkæriɪŋ ɪt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 外送的房間就是我抱它回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tip yourself with the first good sip.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪp jʊrˈsɛlf wɪð ðə fɜrst ɡʊd sɪp./
dialogue.zh: 第一口好喝，就是給自己的小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bag handle, one knot, off I go.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ ˈhændəl, wʌn nɑt, ɔf aɪ ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 提著袋，打一個結，我走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go well, shake before the first sip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ wɛl, ʃeɪk bɪˈfɔr ðə fɜrst sɪp./
dialogue.zh: 一路好走，第一口前先搖一搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake, right, the lesson I forgot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk, raɪt, ðə ˈlɛsən aɪ fɚˈɡɑt./
dialogue.zh: 搖，對，那堂我忘記的課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free crash course, ten seconds total.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri kræʃ kɔrs, tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 免費突擊班，總共十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten seconds, can I learn it here?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz, kæn aɪ lɜrn ɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 十秒就好？我可以在這學嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand here, hold the cup at chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd hɪr, hoʊld ðə kʌp æt tʃɛst./
dialogue.zh: 站這裡，杯子捧在胸口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like holding a tiny surprised cat?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə ˈtaɪni sɚˈpraɪzd kæt?/
dialogue.zh: 像抱一隻受驚的小貓那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, but shake with your wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, bʌt ʃeɪk wɪð jʊr rɪst./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，但用手腕搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrist, not arm, good difference to know.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪst, nɑt ɑrm, ɡʊd ˈdɪfərəns tu noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 手腕不是手臂，這個差別值得記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten quick shakes, then stop, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn kwɪk ʃeɪks, ðɛn stɑp, dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 快搖十下，停，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten, stop, done, that is the whole class?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn, stɑp, dʌn, ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl klæs?/
dialogue.zh: 十下、停、結束，就整堂課？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whole class, paid in full with a smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl klæs, peɪd ɪn fʊl wɪð ə smaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 整堂課，用一個微笑付清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile paid, now out into the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /smaɪl peɪd, naʊ aʊt ˈɪntu ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 微笑付清，現在出門面對熱氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the door, it sticks in heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə dɔr, ɪt stɪks ɪn hit./
dialogue.zh: 小心門，天氣熱它會卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sticky door, a final boss, understood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪki dɔr, ə ˈfaɪnəl bɔs, ˌʌndɚˈstʊd./
dialogue.zh: 卡卡門是最終魔王，收到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Defeat it gently, keep the pearls safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈfit ɪt ˈdʒɛntli, kip ðə pɜrlz seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 溫柔打敗它，保護好珍珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pearls safe, pudding calm, lid sealed.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrlz seɪf, ˈpʊdɪŋ kɑm, lɪd siːld./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠安穩，布丁鎮定，封口完整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk proud, mission accomplished.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk praʊd, ˈmɪʃən əˈkɑmplɪʃt./
dialogue.zh: 驕傲地走，任務圓滿達成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mission mode on, off to find my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪʃən moʊd ɑn, ɔf tə faɪnd maɪ frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 任務模式開啟，出發去找我朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the sharing plan, you mentioned it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ, ðə ˈʃɛrɪŋ plæn, ju mɛnˈʃənd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 啊，那個分飲計畫，你提過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sharing one large? No, I got medium.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɛrɪŋ wʌn lɑrdʒ? noʊ, aɪ ɡɑt ˈmidiəm./
dialogue.zh: 分享一大杯？不，我買中杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Splitting medium is half the fun anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsplɪtɪŋ ˈmidiəm ɪz hæf ðə fʌn ˈɛniˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 反正中杯分著喝才是樂趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half the fun, she will say half the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðə fʌn, ʃi wɪl seɪ hæf ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 一半的樂趣，她會說一半的杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, equal shares, no drama.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps, ˈikwəl ʃɛrz, noʊ ˈdrɑmə./
dialogue.zh: 兩個杯，平均分配，沒有戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No drama, the tea lawyer speaks.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdrɑmə, ðə ti ˈlɔɪɚ spiks./
dialogue.zh: 沒有戲，茶的法律顧問發話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Case closed, go meet your friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /keɪs kloʊzd, ɡoʊ mit jʊr frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 案子結了，快去見你朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed case, open bag, that is my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd keɪs, ˈoʊpən bæɡ, ðæt ɪz maɪ dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 關案、開袋，我的工作內容。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Promoted to bag opener, big career.
dialogue.phonetic: /proʊˈmoʊtɪd tu bæɡ ˈoʊpənɚ, bɪɡ kəˈrɪr./
dialogue.zh: 升官變成開袋師，大好前程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bag opener, it sounds like a superpower.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ ˈoʊpənɚ, ɪt saʊndz laɪk ə ˈsupɚˌkaʊɚ./
dialogue.zh: 開袋師，聽起來像超能力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear it well out there in the sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪt wɛl aʊt ðɛr ɪn ðə sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 到外面陽光下，把超能力穿好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sun, shade, friend, bench, plan complete.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn, ʃeɪd, frɛnd, bɛntʃ, plæn kəmˈplit./
dialogue.zh: 陽光、樹蔭、朋友、長椅，計畫完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bench by the window, classic spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛntʃ baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ, ˈklæsɪk spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那張長椅，經典座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Classic spot for classic pearl sharing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk spɑt fɚ ˈklæsɪk pɜrl ˈʃɛrɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 經典座位配經典分珍珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Share the pearls fairly, count them out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛr ðə pɜrlz ˈfɛrli, kaʊnt ðɛm aʊt laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠要公平分，大聲數出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count pearls out loud, new friendship test.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt pɜrlz aʊt laʊd, nu ˈfrɛndʃɪp tɛst./
dialogue.zh: 大聲數珍珠，友誼新考題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pass, friendships grow stronger after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pæs, ˈfrɛndʃɪps ɡroʊ ˈstrɔŋɡɚ ˈæftɚ./
dialogue.zh: 及格，友誼之後會更結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After this, she wants her own order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftɚ ðɪs, ʃi wɑnts hɜr oʊn ˈɔrdɚ./
dialogue.zh: 這杯之後，她想點自己的那杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then teach her the whole forty-two journey.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn titʃ hɜr ðə hoʊl ˈfɔrti tu ˈdʒɜrni./
dialogue.zh: 那就教她完整的四十二號旅程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The journey starts with a long line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdʒɜrni stɑrts wɪð ə lɔŋ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 旅程從長長的隊伍開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And ends with two spoons on a bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɛndz wɪð tu spunz ɑn ə bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 在一張椅上的兩支湯匙中結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two spoons, one pudding, true friendship.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu spunz, wʌn ˈpʊdɪŋ, tru ˈfrɛndʃɪp./
dialogue.zh: 兩支匙、一份布丁，真友誼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go now, your friend watches from the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ naʊ, jʊr frɛnd ˈwɑtʃɪz frʌm ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 去吧，你朋友已經在窗邊看你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, the door fought me again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, ðə dɔr fɔt mi əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，那門又跟我打了一架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You made it, and the bag still sings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ɪt, ænd ðə bæɡ stɪl sɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 你到了，袋子還在唱，那是冰的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, the important duty: shake it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, ði ɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈduti: ʃeɪk ɪt wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 先執行重要任務：好好搖勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me the wrist lesson, do it slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðə rɪst ˈlɛsən, du ɪt sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 把手腕那一課秀給我，慢動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch the wrist, fast ten, then stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə rɪst, fæst tɛn, ðɛn stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 看著手腕，快搖十下，停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, the bag is dancing in your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðə bæɡ ɪz ˈdænsɪŋ ɪn jʊr hændz./
dialogue.zh: 哇，袋子在你手上跳舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dancing bag, serious shaker in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdænsɪŋ bæɡ, ˈsɪriəs ˈʃekɚ ɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 跳舞的袋子，裡頭住了個搖晃高手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it up, let me see inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt ʌp, lɛt mi si ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 打開來，讓我看看裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? Even color, milk met the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? ˈivən ˈkʌlɚ, mɪlk mɛt ðə ti./
dialogue.zh: 看？顏色均勻了，奶跟茶見面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beautiful merge, ten seconds well spent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbjutəfəl mɜrdʒ, tɛn ˈsɛkəndz wɛl spɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 美麗的融合，十秒花得值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the two-straw operation begins.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə tu strɔ ˌɑpəˈreɪʃən bɪˈɡɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 現在，雙吸管行動正式開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I brought two cups, plan B is better.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt tu kʌps, plæn bi ɪz ˈbɛtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我帶了兩個杯子，B計畫更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two spare cups? You are prepared today.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu spɛr kʌps? ju ɑr prɪˈpɪrd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 還有備用杯？你今天有備而來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always ready for a bubble tea split.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz ˈrɛdi fɚ ə ˈbʌbəl ti splɪt./
dialogue.zh: 隨時準備好分一杯手搖飲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, we split by looking carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, wi splɪt baɪ lʊkɪŋ ˈkɛrfəli./
dialogue.zh: 首先，我們用眼睛平均分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half by eye, one more drop if unsure.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf baɪ aɪ, wʌn mɔr drɑp ɪf ʌnˈʃʊr./
dialogue.zh: 目測一半，不確定再滴一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You poured a little too much, I saw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pɔrd ə ˈlɪtəl tu mʌtʃ, aɪ sɔ./
dialogue.zh: 妳倒多了一點點，我看見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your eagle eyes caught that, take a pearl.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈiɡəl aɪz kɔt ðæt, teɪk ə pɜrl./
dialogue.zh: 你鷹眼抓到了，賠償一顆珍珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pearl as fine, that is fair law.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pɜrl æz faɪn, ðæt ɪz fɛr lɔ./
dialogue.zh: 一顆珍珠當罰金，這是公平法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair law passed, now the pudding question.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr lɔ pæst, naʊ ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ ˈkwɛstʃən./
dialogue.zh: 公平法通過，接著是布丁問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pudding, we cannot split with a straw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ, wi ˈkænɑt splɪt wɪð ə strɔ./
dialogue.zh: 布丁這種東西，吸管分不開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spoons, my friend, spoons solve everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /spunz, maɪ frɛnd, spunz sɑlv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 要用湯匙，朋友，湯匙解決一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You carry spoons too? What is next, maps?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈkæri spunz tu? wʌt ɪz nɛkst, mæps?/
dialogue.zh: 你連湯匙都帶？下一步是什麼，地圖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow: maps to the next tea shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ: mæps tu ðə nɛkst ti ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 明天：前往下一家茶飲店的地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maps accepted, first the pudding cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæps ɪkˈsɛptɪd, fɜrst ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ kʌt./
dialogue.zh: 地圖收下了，先分布丁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slice down the middle, clean as math class.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪs daʊn ðə ˈmɪdəl, klin æz mæθ klæs./
dialogue.zh: 從中間直切，乾淨得像數學課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect halves, even the wobble matches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt hævz, ˈivən ðə ˈwɑbəl ˈmætʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 完美兩半，連晃動都一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh pudding always wobbles like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ ˈpʊdɪŋ ˈɔlweɪz ˈwɑbəlz laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 新鮮的布丁本來就這樣晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh pudding wobbles, note for the world.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ ˈpʊdɪŋ ˈwɑbəlz, noʊt fɚ ðə wɜrld./
dialogue.zh: 新布丁會晃，記給全世界。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will whisper it to every new friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈwɪspɚ ɪt tu ˈɛvri nu frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 我會悄悄告訴每個新朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First sip ceremony, are you ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst sɪp ˈsɛrəˌmoʊni, ɑr ju ˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 第一口儀式，準備好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready, straws in, three, two, one, sip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi, strɔz ɪn, θri, tu, wʌn, sɪp./
dialogue.zh: 好了，吸管插好、三、二、一，吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed eyes, that is the tea nodding.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd aɪz, ðæt ɪz ðə ti ˈnɔdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 閉上眼，那是茶在點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jasmine nods back, forty was right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdʒæzmɪn nɑdz bæk, ˈfɔrti wʌz raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 茉莉茶也點頭回報，四成剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pearls arrive, we chew in respectful silence.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrlz əˈraɪv, wi tʃu ɪn rɪˈspɛktˌfəl ˈsaɪləns./
dialogue.zh: 珍珠來了，我們滿懷敬意，安靜地嚼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chew music, the best sound on benches.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃu ˈmjuzɪk, ðə bɛst saʊnd ɑn ˈbɛntʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 咀嚼之樂，長椅上最美的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not chew too loud, the pigeons judge.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tʃu tu laʊd, ðə ˈpɪdʒənz dʒʌdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 別嚼太大聲，鴿子會評審。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pigeons never had pearls, their votes mean nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪdʒənz ˈnɛvɚ hæd pɜrlz, ðɛr voʊts min ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 鴿子又沒有珍珠，它們的票不算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold in the straw, heat on the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɪn ðə strɔ, hit ɑn ðə strit./
dialogue.zh: 吸管裡是涼的，街上還是熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bench in the shade, summer solved.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛntʃ ɪn ðə ʃeɪd, ˈsʌmɚ sɑlvd./
dialogue.zh: 長椅在樹蔭裡，夏天解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This half cup tastes like a small holiday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs hæf kʌp teɪsts laɪk ə smɔl ˈhɑləˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這半杯喝起來像一個小假期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Holiday economy: one medium, split twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑləˌdeɪ ɪˈkɑnəmi: wʌn ˈmidiəm, splɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 假期經濟學：一中杯，分兩倍快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice? You are already planning round two.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs? ju ɑr ɔlˈrɛdi ˈplænɪŋ raʊnd tu./
dialogue.zh: 兩倍？你已經在規畫第二輪了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, oolong large, you know the drill.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ, ˈuˌlʊŋ lɑrdʒ, ju noʊ ðə drɪl./
dialogue.zh: 明天大杯烏龍，流程你懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drill: line, menu, forty, less ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drɪl: laɪn, ˈmɛnju, ˈfɔrti, lɛs aɪs./
dialogue.zh: 流程就是：排隊、看單、四成、少冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus double pearls, we are brave now.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌs ˈdʌbəl pɜrlz, wi ɑr breɪv naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 外加雙珍珠，我們現在很勇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brave and sharing, the rarest combo.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪv ænd ˈʃɛrɪŋ, ðə ˈrɛərist ˈkɑmboʊ./
dialogue.zh: 又勇敢又愛分享，最稀有的組合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Study says: tea friends share more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstʌdi sɛz: ti frɛndz ʃɛr mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 研究說：喝茶的朋友更捨得分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last pearl stands on the cup bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst pɜrl stændz ɑn ðə kʌp ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 最後一顆珍珠立在杯底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rock paper scissors decides the tiny crown.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɑk ˈpeɪpɚ ˈsɪzɚz dɪˈsaɪdz ðə ˈtaɪni kraʊn./
dialogue.zh: 用剪刀石頭布決定小皇冠歸誰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scissors wins, the crown travels to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪzɚz wɪnz, ðə kraʊn ˈtrævəlz tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 剪刀贏了，皇冠往我這裡搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ceremony accepted, wear it slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛrəˌmoʊni ɪkˈsɛptɪd, wɛr ɪt ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 儀式通過，慢慢戴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sipping slow, the jewel deserves respect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪpɪŋ sloʊ, ðə dʒuəl dɪˈzɜrvz rɪˈspɛkt./
dialogue.zh: 小口小口喝，珠玉值得尊敬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine empties faster, do not judge me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ˈɛmptiz ˈfæstɚ, du nɑt dʒʌdʒ mi./
dialogue.zh: 我那杯空比較快，別評我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No judging, we shake differently.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌdʒɪŋ, wi ʃeɪk dɪˈfɜrəntli./
dialogue.zh: 不評審，我們只是搖法不同。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow sips or fast sips, tea approves.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ sɪps ɔr fæst sɪps, ti əˈpruvz./
dialogue.zh: 慢飲或快飲，茶都同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice left at the bottom, small diamonds.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs lɛft æt ðə ˈbɑtəm, smɔl daɪməndz./
dialogue.zh: 杯底剩下的冰，小小的鑽石。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crunch them like snow from a good movie.
dialogue.phonetic: /krʌntʃ ðɛm laɪk snoʊ frʌm ə ɡʊd ˈmuvi./
dialogue.zh: 嚼它們，像好電影裡的雪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crunch heard across the whole bench now.
dialogue.phonetic: /krʌntʃ hɜrd əˈkrɔs ðə hoʊl bɛntʃ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 整張長椅都聽見那聲脆響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pigeons clap, I promise, listen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪdʒənz klæp, aɪ ˈprɑmɪs, ˈlɪsən./
dialogue.zh: 鴿子在鼓掌，我發誓，你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wings clap, fine, you win the sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪŋz klæp, faɪn, ju wɪn ðə saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 翅膀在拍，好啦，聲音你贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sound champion of the bubble tea bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊnd ˈtʃæmpiən əv ðə ˈbʌbəl ti bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 手搖飲長椅區的聲音冠軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Champion titles and half a cup of tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃæmpiən ˈtaɪtəlz ænd hæf ə kʌp əv ti./
dialogue.zh: 冠軍頭銜加半杯茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My kingdom is small, but sweet today.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkɪŋdəm ɪz smɔl, bʌt swit təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我的王國很小，但今天很甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long live the half cup queen, cheers.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ lɪv ðə hæf kʌp kwin, tʃɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 半杯女王萬萬歲，乾杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheers, clink the empty cups gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪrz, klɪŋk ði ˈɛmti kʌps ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 乾杯，空杯子輕輕碰一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clink done, best tiny concert ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪŋk dʌn, bɛst ˈtaɪni ˈkɑnsɚt ˈɛvɚ./
dialogue.zh: 碰完了，史上最迷你的音樂會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next tour date: the shop across town.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst tʊr deɪt: ðə ʃɑp əˈkrɔs taʊn./
dialogue.zh: 下一場巡演：城那頭那家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tour manager hired: me, apparently.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʊr ˈmænɪdʒɚ ˈhaɪɪzd: mi, əˈpɛrəntli./
dialogue.zh: 巡演經理錄用了：就是我本人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You plan maps, I plan the topping list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju plæn mæps, aɪ plæn ðə ˈtɑpɪŋ lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 你排地圖，我排加料清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split duties, split cups, split bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /splɪt dʒutiz, splɪt kʌps, splɪt bɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 分工、分杯、也分帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fairest friendship math I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɛərɪst ˈfrɛndʃɪp mæθ aɪ noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這是友誼裡最公道的數學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Math class was never this tasty.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæθ klæs wʌz ˈnɛvɚ ðɪs ˈteɪsti./
dialogue.zh: 數學課從來沒這麼好吃過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New school rule: tea counts as study.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu skul rul: ti kaʊnts æz ˈstʌdi./
dialogue.zh: 新校規：喝茶算唸書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Study complete, diploma of the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstʌdi kəmˈplit, dɪˈploʊmə əv ðə bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 唸完了，長椅的畢業證書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear it proudly into the sunset walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪt ˈpraʊdli ˈɪntu ðə ˈsʌnˌsɛt wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 驕傲地戴著它走進夕陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunset walks and empty bags of ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌsɛt wɔks ænd ˈɛmti bæɡz əv aɪs./
dialogue.zh: 夕陽散步，和裝過冰塊的空袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Recycle the receipt, blue bin, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈraɪsəkəl ðə rɪˈsit, blu bɪn, rɪˈmɛmbɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 收據丟回收，藍桶，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue bin duty, I would never forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu bɪn ˈduti, aɪ wʊd ˈnɛvɚ fɚˈɡɛt./
dialogue.zh: 藍桶的任務，我絕不會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good student, the counter would be proud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈstudənt, ðə ˈkaʊntɚ wʊd bi praʊd./
dialogue.zh: 好學生，櫃台會以你為榮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They waved when we walked out, I saw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ weɪvd wɛn wi wɔkt aʊt, aɪ sɔ./
dialogue.zh: 我們出門時他們揮手了，我看見的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They smile often, it is a shop habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ smaɪl ˈɔfən, ɪt ɪz ə ʃɑp ˈhæbɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他們常笑，那是店裡的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shops like this make evenings softer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑps laɪk ðɪs meɪk ˈivənɪŋz ˈsɔftɚ./
dialogue.zh: 這樣的店，會讓傍晚變柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Evenings are better with one split cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivənɪŋz ɑr ˈbɛtɚ wɪð wʌn splɪt kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 有一杯分享的傍晚更美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow's order, same hour, same bench?
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊz ˈɔrdɚ, seɪm ˈaʊɚ, seɪm bɛntʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 明天的約：同一時間、同一張椅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same hour, same bench, different tea adventure.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈaʊɚ, seɪm bɛntʃ, ˈdɪfɚənt ti ædˈvɛntʃɚ./
dialogue.zh: 同一時間同一椅，茶冒險換一關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adventure booked, forty sugar, double pearls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ædˈvɛntʃɚ bʊkt, ˈfɔrti ˈʃʊɡɚ, ˈdʌbəl pɜrlz./
dialogue.zh: 冒險已訂：四成糖、雙珍珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Confirmed on my imaginary stamp right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈfɜrmd ɑn maɪ ɪˈmædʒɪˌnɛri stæmp raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我那個想像印章現在就蓋下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stamped twice, no take-backs allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæmpt twaɪs, noʊ teɪk bæks əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 蓋兩次章，不接受收回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friend contracts seal themselves at tea shops.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛnd ˈkɑnˌtrækts sil ðɛmˈsɛlvz æt ti ʃɑps./
dialogue.zh: 朋友的合約，在手搖店自動生效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night air and pearl-sweet fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ɛr ænd pɜrl swit ˈfɪŋɡɚz./
dialogue.zh: 夜晚的空氣，和甜甜珍珠的手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet fingers, quiet streets, perfect evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit ˈfɪŋɡɚz, ˈkwaɪət strits, ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈivənɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 甜甜手指，靜靜街道，完美夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same plan tomorrow, oolong and all.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm plæn təˈmɑroʊ, ˈuˌlʊŋ ænd ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 明天同樣規畫，烏龍那些全部。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oolong and all, plus the tall friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈuˌlʊŋ ænd ɔl, plʌs ðə tɔl frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 烏龍全套，外加那位高個兒朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The large cup finally gets its day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɑrdʒ kʌp ˈfaɪnəli ɡɛts ɪts deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 大杯終於輪到它的主場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two straws again, peace begins again.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu strɔz əˈɡɛn, pis bɪˈɡɪnz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 兩根吸管，和平重新開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peace, tea, and a bench by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /pis, ti, ænd ə bɛntʃ baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 和平、茶，還有窗邊那張椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more plan, tomorrow, same long line.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr plæn, təˈmɑroʊ, seɪm lɔŋ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 最後再加一項計畫：明天，同一條長隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodnight, my favorite person to split with.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɡʊdˈnaɪt, maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt ˈpɜrsən tə splɪt wɪð./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，我最想一起分一杯的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight, and save me a spot in line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɡʊdˈnaɪt, ænd seɪv mi ə spɑt ɪn laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，幫我在隊伍裡留一個位置。
